def _authenticate_incident_20261010_current_sources():
    """Authenticate incident successors freshly, or reuse only inside this audit scope."""
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_checkpoint_e_completion_v8 as receipt_scope

    scope = receipt_scope._active_receipt_scope("checkpoint-master-audit")
    key = "checkpoint-master.incident-20261010-source-identities"
    contract = None
    if scope is not None:
        require(scope.enabled,
                "incident source derivation requires an enabled checkpoint scope")
        contract = _checkpoint_direct_contract_digest(sys.modules[__name__], a2)
        cached = scope.load_derivation(key, contract)
        if cached is not None:
            identities = json.loads(cached)
            require(type(identities) is dict
                    and set(identities) == set(INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS)
                    and all(type(value) is str and len(value) == 64
                            for value in identities.values()),
                    "incident source derivation payload is malformed")
            for path, expected in identities.items():
                raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
                require(sha(raw) == expected,
                        "incident successor source changed during checkpoint scope: " + path)
            if contract != _checkpoint_direct_contract_digest(sys.modules[__name__], a2):
                raise AssertionError("incident source verifier changed during scoped reuse")
            return

    latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    rows = {row["path"]: row for row in latest["source_identities"]}
    identities = {}
    for path in INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS:
        row = rows.get(path)
        require(row is not None, "incident successor source is absent from current A2 inventory: " + path)
        raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
        current = sha(raw)
        require(
            current == row["lf_source_sha256"],
            "incident successor source differs from authenticated A2 bytes: " + path,
        )
        identities[path] = current
    if scope is not None:
        if contract != _checkpoint_direct_contract_digest(sys.modules[__name__], a2):
            raise AssertionError("incident source verifier changed during scoped authentication")
        scope.store_derivation(key, contract, canonical_json_bytes(identities))

def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False,
                       allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def self_sha(value):
    return sha(canonical({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "canonical_sha256"}))


def seal(value):
    value["canonical_sha256"] = self_sha(value)
    return value

def historical_audit_forward(base):
    before = read(HISTORICAL_AUDIT_FIXTURE)
    identity = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(before)).encode() + b"\0" + before).hexdigest()
    require(identity == base["files"][HISTORICAL_AUDIT]["git_blob_sha1"], "historical audit before fixture drift")
    anchor = b'    historical_inventory = b"".join(row for row in rows.splitlines(keepends=True)\n'
    addition = (
        b'    # The immutable remediation checkpoint predates these two additive C4\n'
        b'    # documents. Authenticate their exact sealed identities before excluding\n'
        b'    # them from the historical inventory; every old artifact remains pinned.\n'
        b'    from scripts.audit_checkpoint_e_workflows import verified_additive_artifact_paths\n'
        b'    additive_paths = verified_additive_artifact_paths()\n'
    )
    old = b'                                    if row.split(b"\\t", 1)[1].strip() != RECEIPT_PATH.encode())\n'
    new = (b'                                    if row.split(b"\\t", 1)[1].strip() not in\n'
           b'                                    {RECEIPT_PATH.encode(), *(path.encode() for path in additive_paths)})\n')
    require(before.count(anchor) == before.count(old) == 1, "historical audit forward anchors ambiguous")
    after = before.replace(anchor, addition + anchor).replace(old, new)
    require(read(HISTORICAL_AUDIT) == after, "historical audit change exceeds authenticated additive artifact allowance")
    return before, hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(after)).encode() + b"\0" + after).hexdigest()

        transition["transition_id"] == "CORE01D_FRESH_HOLDOUT_PR119_RELEASE_ONLY_BOOTSTRAP_V1"
        and transition["workflow_path"] == path
        and transition["operation"] == "MAINTENANCE_REVISE"
        and transition["phase_id"] == "CORE-01D"
        and transition["canonical_family"] == "PROTECTED_RESEARCH"
        and transition["before"]["git_blob_sha1"] == before["git_blob_sha1"]
        and observed is not None
        and observed["mode"] == before["mode"]
        and observed["git_blob_sha1"] == transition["after"]["git_blob_sha1"],
        "fresh-holdout current source differs from its exact transition-14 identity",
    )
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_checkpoint_e_completion_v8 as receipt_scope
    with receipt_scope._bounded_receipt_scope(
            "checkpoint-retained-status-v2", (retained_status_v2,),
            retained_status_v2._TRUSTED_RETAINED_STATUS_V2_CONTRACT):
        status = retained_status_v2.audit()

            status.get("result") == "PASS"
            and status.get("evolution_ledger_sha256") == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_LEDGER_SHA256
            and status.get("workflow_tree_sha1") == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_WORKFLOW_TREE_SHA1,
            "current retained-status V2 did not authenticate the exact transition-14 source",
        )
        supporting = retained_status_v2.build_receipt()["pass1_supporting_source_inventory"]
    require(
        [row["path"] for row in supporting] == list(retained_status_v2.SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PATHS),
        "Pass-1 supporting source inventory path set drift",
    )
    historical_supporting_predecessors = (
        retained_status_v2.HISTORICAL_SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS
    )
    for row in supporting:
        path = row["path"]
        observed_support = current.get(path)
        predecessor = historical_supporting_predecessors.get(path)
        if predecessor is not None:
            # Status V2 authenticates the current source through A2, then
            # authenticates this exact retained predecessor fixture. Keep the
            # Pass-1 projection on that predecessor instead of comparing it
            # with the intentionally changed current source bytes.
            require(
                observed_support is not None
                and observed_support["mode"] == "100644"
                and row["git_blob_sha1"] == predecessor["git_blob_sha1"]
                and row["source_sha256"] == predecessor["source_sha256"],
                "Pass-1 supporting predecessor differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
            )
        else:
            require(
                observed_support is not None
                and observed_support["git_blob_sha1"] == row["git_blob_sha1"],
                "Pass-1 supporting source differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
            )
    return {
        "workflow_blob": transition["after"]["git_blob_sha1"],
        "supporting_source_blobs": {
            row["path"]: row["git_blob_sha1"] for row in supporting
        },
    }

        if path in FRESH_HOLDOUT_20261014_TEST_TREE_IDENTITIES:

            # These current workflow/test successors are also authenticated

            else INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS[path] if path in INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS

def parity_evidence():
    rows = []
    for clock in ("09:00", "22:59", "23:00"):
        now = datetime.fromisoformat(f"2026-10-01T{clock}:00+00:00")
        scheduled = resolve_workflow_request(event_name="schedule", now=now)
        require((scheduled.authority_profile, scheduled.mode, scheduled.target_legs,
                 scheduled.bookie, scheduled.create_share_code, scheduled.place_wager) ==
                ("MAIN", "main_application", 20, "sportybet", False, False), "scheduled MAIN semantics changed")
        for suffix in ("scope=today", "scope=three-day", "dates=20261001", "dates=20261002,20261003"):
            result = comment.resolve_comment("/athena-shadow target=20 " + suffix, now=now)
            representable = clock != "23:00" or suffix == "dates=20261002,20261003"
            require((result.compatibility_status == comment.REPRESENTABLE) is representable, "date-shifting parity claim")
            if representable:
                # Preserve legacy intent for the parity proof. This is parsing,
                # not authority to create a code, and is never executed.
                request = parse_explicit_request(
                    days=",".join(datetime.strptime(day, "%Y%m%d").date().isoformat()
                                  for day in result.legacy_utc_resolved_dates),
                    target_legs=20, profile="shadow", create_share_code=True, now=now,
                )
                require(canonical_json_bytes(request) == result.canonical_request_bytes, "legacy request byte parity differs")
            else:
                require(result.canonical_request_bytes is None and result.canonical_request_sha256 is None, "fabricated canonical request for unrepresentable UTC intent")
            rows.append({"clock_utc": now.isoformat(), "legacy_input": suffix,
                         "status": result.compatibility_status, "legacy_dates": list(result.legacy_utc_resolved_dates),
                         "canonical_request_sha256": result.canonical_request_sha256,
                         "delivery_compatibility_intent": True, "date_shift": False,
                         "execution_authorized_by_test": False})
    return rows

def reachability(path, name, artifact_names, texts):
    identifiers = sorted({path, Path(path).name, name, *artifact_names})
    matches = []
    for source, text in texts.items():
        if source == path:
            continue
        lines = []
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            hits = [term for term in identifiers if term and term in line]
            if hits:
                lines.append({"line": number, "identifiers": hits})
        if lines:
            matches.append({"path": source, "matches": lines,
                            "classification": "DOCS" if source.startswith("docs/") else
                            "TEST" if source.startswith("tests/") else "SOURCE_OR_WORKFLOW"})
    return {"scan_basis": "EXACT_BASE_TRACKED_SOURCE_NOT_ZERO_GREP_RETIREMENT_PROOF",
            "matches": matches, "dynamic_subprocess_reachability": "NOT_PROVEN_FOR_RETIREMENT",
            "retirement_reachability_pass": False}

        | pass_a_v2.PASS_A_V2_AUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS

    )
    require(
        type(historical_source_predecessors) is dict
        and set(historical_source_predecessors) <= allowed_predecessor_paths,
        "historical reachability scan received an unapproved source predecessor",
    )
    for path, raw in historical_source_predecessors.items():
        expected = base["files"].get(path)
        require(
            path in base["scan_paths"]
            and expected is not None
            and expected.get("mode") == "100644"
            and type(raw) is bytes,
            "historical reachability scan predecessor is outside the immutable source inventory: " + path,
        )
        if path == TESTS_WORKFLOW:
            require(
                raw == tests_source.historical_workflow_source(),
                "Checkpoint-E Tests workflow predecessor was not independently authenticated",
            )
        if path == tests_source.CENSUS_TEST:
            require(
                raw == tests_source.historical_census_test_source(),
                "Checkpoint-E census predecessor was not independently authenticated",
            )
        blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        require(
            blob == expected.get("git_blob_sha1"),
            "historical reachability scan predecessor differs from the immutable source inventory: " + path,
        )
    texts = {path: read(path).decode("utf-8") for path in base["scan_paths"]}

    old = strict(read("artifacts/architecture/p4_3_workflow_capability_matrix_v1.json"))
    old_rows = {row["workflow_path"]: row for row in old["workflow_rows"]}
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(p for p in base["files"] if p.startswith(".github/workflows/") and p.endswith((".yml", ".yaml"))):
        # This matrix reconstructs the immutable Checkpoint-E V1 view, so an
        # authenticated predecessor is used for both reachability and YAML
        # metadata. Current workflow authority is validated separately against
        # the exact current tree and A2/shard-successor evidence.
        raw = (historical_source_predecessors[path]
               if path in historical_source_predecessors else read(path))
        doc = yaml.load(raw, Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
        require(type(doc) is dict and type(doc.get("on")) is dict, f"unsupported trigger shape: {path}")
        name = doc.get("name", Path(path).stem)
        steps = census._steps(doc)
        uploads, downloads = census._artifacts(steps)
        artifacts = sorted({row["name"] for row in uploads if row["name"]})
        historical = old_rows.get(path, {})
        family = historical.get("successor_family", "RETAIN_PENDING_AUDIT")

        reason = "Canonical family retained unchanged" if status == "CANONICAL_SUPPORTED" else (

        )
        if historical.get("date_hardcoded"):

            reason = "Frozen dated evidence workflow, not a supported current football run; dependent evidence consumers and retention require individual retirement proof"
        refs = reachability(path, name, artifacts, texts)
        surfaces = []
        for trigger, detail in sorted(doc["on"].items()):

                "authority_profile": "MAIN" if main else "MAIN_OR_SHADOW_EXPLICIT" if canonical_run else "SHADOW" if shadow else "UNKNOWN_NOT_RECLASSIFIED_BY_CENSUS",
                "acquisition_authority": False if main else "EXPLICIT_SHADOW_ONLY" if canonical_run else True if shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "delivery_authority": False if main else "EXPLICIT_CREATE_SHARE_CODE_INTENT" if canonical_run else "LEGACY_IMPLICIT_TRUE_RETAINED_NOT_EXECUTED_IN_C4" if shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "wager_authority": False if canonical_run or shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "request_parser_owner": "services/athena_run_workflow_request.py" if canonical_run else "services/athena_shadow_issue_comment_compatibility.py" if shadow and trigger == "issue_comment" else path,

                surface["successor_request_parity"] = "09Z_DATE_PARITY_ONLY_NO_REVIEWED_MULTI_PROFILE_SCHEDULE"
                surface["retained_reason"] = "Preserve MAIN-only canonical schedule and single-request/run artifact identity; multi-profile schedule/archive ownership needs explicit reviewed design; legacy implicit delivery is not analysis-only byte parity"
            if shadow and trigger == "issue_comment":
                surface["retained_reason"] = "Exact #276/owner grammars retained; UTC 23Z requests can be unrepresentable; legacy true delivery intent cannot silently become false; no implicit hybrid execution"

def checkpoint_status(criteria):
    require(type(criteria) is dict and criteria and all(type(v) is bool for v in criteria.values()), "criteria must be explicit booleans")
    blockers = sorted(key for key, value in criteria.items() if not value)
    return ("COMPLETE" if not blockers else "INCOMPLETE"), blockers


def validate_retirement_row(row):
    require(row.get("deletion_eligible") is True, "retirement row not eligible")
    require(row.get("last_relevant_historical_runs", {}).get("last_successful"), "missing last successful run evidence")
    require(row.get("rollback"), "missing rollback identity")
    checklist = row.get("retirement_checklist", {})
    require(set(checklist) == set(range(1, 15)) and all(v is True for v in checklist.values()), "full 14-point retirement checklist required")
    require(row.get("supported_callers_remaining") == [] and row.get("required_restore_dependencies") == [], "retired workflow still reachable/required")


def validate_documents(matrix, receipt):
    require(matrix.get("canonical_sha256") == self_sha(matrix) and receipt.get("canonical_sha256") == self_sha(receipt), "matrix/receipt self hash mismatch")
    rows = matrix["workflow_rows"]
    paths = [row["workflow_path"] for row in rows]
    live = sorted(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for path in (ROOT / ".github/workflows").iterdir() if path.suffix in {".yml", ".yaml"})
    require(paths == live and len(set(paths)) == len(paths) == matrix["workflow_count"], "live workflow inventory count/coverage mismatch")
    for row in rows:
        doc = yaml.load(read(row["workflow_path"]), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
        surfaces = row["trigger_surfaces"]
        require([surface["trigger_kind"] for surface in surfaces] == sorted(doc["on"]), "trigger-specific row coverage mismatch")
        require(row["supported_status"] in ALLOWED_STATUS, "workflow lacks successor/retained status")
        for surface in surfaces:
            require(surface["supported_status"] in ALLOWED_STATUS and surface["retained_reason"], "supported surface missing exact retained/successor status")
            require(surface["deletion_eligible"] is False, "unsupported deletion eligibility claim")
    require(sum(len(row["trigger_surfaces"]) for row in rows) == matrix["trigger_surface_count"], "trigger count mismatch")
    require(not any(row["supported_current_runtime_root"] and row["date_hardcoded_historical_evidence"] for row in rows),
            "supported current runtime depends on date-hardcoded workflow")
    status, blockers = checkpoint_status(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"])
    require(receipt["checkpoint_e_status"] == receipt["p4_4_status"] == status and receipt["remaining_blocker_ids"] == blockers, "Checkpoint E COMPLETE with false mandatory criterion")
    require(receipt["workflow_matrix_sha256"] == matrix["canonical_sha256"], "matrix receipt binding mismatch")
    require(receipt["retired_workflows"] == matrix["retired_in_this_pr"] == [], "retirement not proven in this checkpoint")
    accepted = receipt["accepted_lg_a"]
    require((accepted["run_id"], accepted["exact_head"], accepted["artifact_id"], accepted["artifact_name"], accepted["local_zip_sha256"], accepted["attempt"], accepted["terminal"]) ==
            (36860297707, BASE, 11163921301, "athena-run-36860297707", ZIP_SHA, 1, "RESEARCH_SHADOW_PORTFOLIO_READY_WITH_SHORTFALL"), "accepted LG-A run/head/artifact mismatch")
    require(receipt["historical_failed_lg_a"]["restore_eligible"] is False and
            receipt["historical_failed_lg_a"]["disposition"] == "IMMUTABLE_FAILED_NON_RETRYABLE", "failed producer relabeled eligible/successful")
    require(receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["grammars"] == [comment.SCOPE_GRAMMAR, comment.EXPLICIT_DATES_GRAMMAR] and
            receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["issue"] == 276 and
            receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["owner_guard"] == "github.repository_owner", "issue-comment grammar/admission drift")
    require(receipt["notification_disposition"]["legacy"] == "EXPLICIT_RETAINED_SECONDARY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE" and
            receipt["notification_disposition"]["security_integrity_failure"] == "FAIL_CLOSED" and
            receipt["notification_disposition"]["ordinary_transport_failure"] == "EMAIL_FAILED_WARNING_EXIT_ZERO", "notification authority/failure drift")
    require(all(case["date_shift"] is False for case in receipt["date_schedule_disposition"]["parity_evidence"]), "date-shifting parity claim")
    require(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"]["scheduled_shadow_canonical_ownership_proven_preserving_main"] is False,
            "no reviewed multi-profile scheduled SHADOW implementation exists")
    unknown = any(surface["acquisition_authority"] == "UNKNOWN" for row in rows for surface in row["trigger_surfaces"])
    require(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"]["all_retained_workflow_authority_and_dynamic_reachability_review_complete"] is (not unknown), "unknown authority treated as proven")
    require(all(value == 0 and type(value) is int for value in receipt["live_side_effect_counts"].values()) and
            all(value == 0 and type(value) is int for value in receipt["semantic_delta"].values()), "live/semantic authority expansion")

def _checkpoint_direct_contract_digest(*roots):
    """Bind a fixed verifier set without importing its transitive graph on demand.

    D5 authentication lazily imports already-pinned auditor modules. Hashing a
    recursively discovered module graph before and after that call makes normal
    imports look like verifier mutation. This fixed-root digest binds each
    selected module's own functions/constants; repository and A2 state remain
    freshly checked by the enclosing receipt scope.
    """
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    modules = {module.__name__: module for module in roots}
    for module_name, module in sorted(modules.items()):
        digest.update(module_name.encode("utf-8") + b"\0")
        digest.update(repr((id(module), id(sys.modules.get(module_name)))).encode("ascii") + b"\0")
        for name, value in sorted(vars(module).items()):
            if (name == "__builtins__" or name == "_receipt_scope_module"
                    or name.startswith("_TRUSTED_") and name.endswith("_CONTRACT")):
                continue
            digest.update(name.encode("utf-8") + b"\0")
            runtime = _receipt_scope_module._runtime_global(module_name, name, value)
            if runtime is None:
                value = _receipt_scope_module._contract_value(
                    value, include_mutable_contents=True)
            else:
                value = runtime
            digest.update(repr(value).encode("utf-8") + b"\0")
    return digest.hexdigest()

def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False,
                       allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def self_sha(value):
    return sha(canonical({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "canonical_sha256"}))


def seal(value):
    value["canonical_sha256"] = self_sha(value)
    return value

def historical_audit_forward(base):
    before = read(HISTORICAL_AUDIT_FIXTURE)
    identity = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(before)).encode() + b"\0" + before).hexdigest()
    require(identity == base["files"][HISTORICAL_AUDIT]["git_blob_sha1"], "historical audit before fixture drift")
    anchor = b'    historical_inventory = b"".join(row for row in rows.splitlines(keepends=True)\n'
    addition = (
        b'    # The immutable remediation checkpoint predates these two additive C4\n'
        b'    # documents. Authenticate their exact sealed identities before excluding\n'
        b'    # them from the historical inventory; every old artifact remains pinned.\n'
        b'    from scripts.audit_checkpoint_e_workflows import verified_additive_artifact_paths\n'
        b'    additive_paths = verified_additive_artifact_paths()\n'
    )
    old = b'                                    if row.split(b"\\t", 1)[1].strip() != RECEIPT_PATH.encode())\n'
    new = (b'                                    if row.split(b"\\t", 1)[1].strip() not in\n'
           b'                                    {RECEIPT_PATH.encode(), *(path.encode() for path in additive_paths)})\n')
    require(before.count(anchor) == before.count(old) == 1, "historical audit forward anchors ambiguous")
    after = before.replace(anchor, addition + anchor).replace(old, new)
    require(read(HISTORICAL_AUDIT) == after, "historical audit change exceeds authenticated additive artifact allowance")
    return before, hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(after)).encode() + b"\0" + after).hexdigest()

def _authenticate_pr119_release_only_workflow_forward(current, before):
    """Allow only transition 14's exact protected-workflow source identity."""
    path = ".github/workflows/fotmob-utc-native-xg-fresh-holdout.yml"
    from scripts import audit_p4_workflow_evolution_ledger as evolution
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_retained_workflow_status_v2 as retained_status_v2

    require(
        tuple(retained_status_v2.SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PATHS) == PASS1_SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PATHS,
        "checkpoint and retained-status V2 supporting-source contracts differ",
    )
    ledger = evolution.validate_current_state()
    require(
        len(ledger["transitions"]) == 14
        and ledger["canonical_sha256"] == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_LEDGER_SHA256
        and ledger["current_workflow_tree_sha1"] == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_WORKFLOW_TREE_SHA1,
        "fresh-holdout forward is not the exact authenticated transition-14 tree/ledger tuple",
    )
    transition = ledger["transitions"][-1]
    observed = current.get(path)
    require(
        transition["transition_id"] == "CORE01D_FRESH_HOLDOUT_PR119_RELEASE_ONLY_BOOTSTRAP_V1"
        and transition["workflow_path"] == path
        and transition["operation"] == "MAINTENANCE_REVISE"
        and transition["phase_id"] == "CORE-01D"
        and transition["canonical_family"] == "PROTECTED_RESEARCH"
        and transition["before"]["git_blob_sha1"] == before["git_blob_sha1"]
        and observed is not None
        and observed["mode"] == before["mode"]
        and observed["git_blob_sha1"] == transition["after"]["git_blob_sha1"],
        "fresh-holdout current source differs from its exact transition-14 identity",
    )
    status = retained_status_v2.audit()
    require(
        status.get("result") == "PASS"
        and status.get("evolution_ledger_sha256") == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_LEDGER_SHA256
        and status.get("workflow_tree_sha1") == evolution.CORE01D_PR119_WORKFLOW_TREE_SHA1,
        "current retained-status V2 did not authenticate the exact transition-14 source",
    )
    supporting = retained_status_v2.build_receipt()["pass1_supporting_source_inventory"]
    require(
        [row["path"] for row in supporting] == list(retained_status_v2.SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PATHS),
        "Pass-1 supporting source inventory path set drift",
    )
    historical_supporting_predecessors = (
        retained_status_v2.HISTORICAL_SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS
    )
    for row in supporting:
        path = row["path"]
        observed_support = current.get(path)
        predecessor = historical_supporting_predecessors.get(path)
        if predecessor is not None:
            # Status V2 authenticates the current source through A2, then
            # authenticates this exact retained predecessor fixture. Keep the
            # Pass-1 projection on that predecessor instead of comparing it
            # with the intentionally changed current source bytes.
            require(
                observed_support is not None
                and observed_support["mode"] == "100644"
                and row["git_blob_sha1"] == predecessor["git_blob_sha1"]
                and row["source_sha256"] == predecessor["source_sha256"],
                "Pass-1 supporting predecessor differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
            )
        else:
            require(
                observed_support is not None
                and observed_support["git_blob_sha1"] == row["git_blob_sha1"],
                "Pass-1 supporting source differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
            )
    return {
        "workflow_blob": transition["after"]["git_blob_sha1"],
        "supporting_source_blobs": {
            row["path"]: row["git_blob_sha1"] for row in supporting
        },
    }


def base_input(*, include_scan_source_predecessors=False):
    raw = read(BASE_PATH)
    require(sha(raw) == BASE_INPUT_SHA, "exact-main base inventory identity drift")
    value = strict(raw)
    require(value["base_main_sha"] == BASE and value["canonical_sha256"] == self_sha(value), "base input binding drift")
    current = git_inventory()
    _, audit_after = historical_audit_forward(value)
    fresh_workflow_path = ".github/workflows/fotmob-utc-native-xg-fresh-holdout.yml"
    fresh_workflow_after_blob = None
    supporting_source_blobs = {}
    if current.get(fresh_workflow_path) != value["files"].get(fresh_workflow_path):
        forward = _authenticate_pr119_release_only_workflow_forward(
            current, value["files"][fresh_workflow_path]
        )
        fresh_workflow_after_blob = forward["workflow_blob"]
        supporting_source_blobs = forward["supporting_source_blobs"]
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_checkpoint_e_completion_v2 as pass_a_v2
    pass_a_predecessors = None
    pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors = None
    pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs = {}
    pass1_forward_predecessor_sources = {}
    for path, identity in value["files"].items():
        if path == HISTORICAL_AUDIT:
            require(current.get(path) in (identity, {"mode": identity["mode"], "git_blob_sha1": audit_after}), "historical audit forward Git identity differs")
        elif path == fresh_workflow_path and fresh_workflow_after_blob:
            require(
                current.get(path) == {
                    "mode": identity["mode"],
                    "git_blob_sha1": fresh_workflow_after_blob,
                },
                "fresh-holdout workflow differs from its transition-14 identity",
            )
        elif path in supporting_source_blobs:
            from scripts import audit_core_01d_retained_workflow_status_v2 as retained_status_v2
            predecessor = retained_status_v2.HISTORICAL_SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS.get(path)
            expected_support = {
                "mode": identity["mode"],
                "git_blob_sha1": supporting_source_blobs[path],
            }
            if predecessor is not None:
                # The source was edited after Pass-1. Its current bytes were
                # authenticated by Status V2 against A2 above; this immutable
                # base inventory row is older than the later Pass-1
                # predecessor fixture, so authenticate each historical view
                # through its own pinned identity and only require the current
                # path/mode to remain present here.
                require(
                    supporting_source_blobs[path] == predecessor["git_blob_sha1"]
                    and current.get(path) is not None
                    and current[path]["mode"] == identity["mode"],
                    "Pass-1 supporting predecessor differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
                )
            else:
                require(
                    current.get(path) == expected_support,
                    "Pass-1 supporting source differs from its V2 authenticated identity: " + path,
                )
        elif path in PASS_A_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_FIXTURES:
            require(
                identity == {
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "git_blob_sha1": PASS_A_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS[path],
                },
                "Pass-A base inventory differs from its exact V1 source identity: " + path,
            )
        elif path in PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS:
            require(
                identity == {
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "git_blob_sha1": PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS[path],
                }
                and current.get(path) is not None
                and current[path]["mode"] == identity["mode"],
                "Pass-A preserved A2 successor differs from its exact V1 base identity: " + path,
            )
        elif path in pass_a_v2.PASS_A_V2_AUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS:
            if pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors is None:
                latest_a2 = a2.authenticate_inventory()
                pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors = pass_a_v2.authenticate_pass_a_e3_compat_predecessors(
                    a2, latest_a2,
                )
            require(
                identity == {
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "git_blob_sha1": pass_a_v2.PASS_A_E3_COMPAT_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS[path][1],
                }
                and current.get(path) is not None
                and current[path]["mode"] == "100644"
                and pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors[path] == identity["git_blob_sha1"],
                "Pass-1 Pass-A V2 source predecessor identity drift: " + path,
            )
            pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path] = pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors[path]
            fixture = pass_a_v2.PASS_A_E3_COMPAT_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS[path][0]
            predecessor_source = a2.lf((ROOT / fixture).read_bytes())
            predecessor_source_blob = hashlib.sha1(
                b"blob " + str(len(predecessor_source)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + predecessor_source
            ).hexdigest()
            require(
                predecessor_source_blob == pass_a_v2_compat_predecessors[path],
                "Pass-1 Pass-A V2 source predecessor bytes drift: " + path,
            )
            if path in value["scan_paths"]:
                pass1_forward_predecessor_sources[path] = predecessor_source
        elif path in (a2.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS
                      | a2.E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS):
            if path in a2.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS:
                transition = a2.resolve_historical_source_transition(
                    path,
                    expected_generation=a2.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION,
                )
                predecessor_mode = successor_mode = "100644"
                predecessor_reader = a2.read_authenticated_cross_contract_predecessor
            else:
                transition = a2.resolve_historical_source_transition(
                    path,
                    expected_generation=a2.E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION,
                )
                predecessor_mode = transition["predecessor_git_mode"]
                successor_mode = transition["successor_git_mode"]
                predecessor_reader = None
            expected_predecessor = {
                "mode": predecessor_mode,
                "git_blob_sha1": transition["predecessor_git_blob_sha1"],
            }
            if identity == expected_predecessor and current.get(path) != identity:
                if predecessor_reader is not None:
                    predecessor = predecessor_reader(path)
                else:
                    if pass_a_predecessors is None:
                        pass_a_predecessors = a2.read_authenticated_pass_a_source_predecessors()
                    predecessor = pass_a_predecessors[path]
                predecessor_lf = predecessor.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
                predecessor_blob = hashlib.sha1(
                    b"blob " + str(len(predecessor)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + predecessor
                ).hexdigest()
                require(
                    len(predecessor) == transition["predecessor_byte_size"]
                    and predecessor_blob == transition["predecessor_git_blob_sha1"]
                    and hashlib.sha256(predecessor_lf).hexdigest()
                        == transition["predecessor_lf_source_sha256"]
                    and current.get(path) == {
                        "mode": successor_mode,
                        "git_blob_sha1": transition["successor_git_blob_sha1"],
                    },
                    "Pass-1 V284/V300 source predecessor/successor identity drift: " + path,
                )
                pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path] = predecessor_blob
                if path in value["scan_paths"]:
                    pass1_forward_predecessor_sources[path] = predecessor
            else:
                # An earlier historical owner may project a different exact
                # Pass-1 blob for a V284/V300 path. Preserve that precedence;
                # only a base row equal to the authorized predecessor can use
                # this transition.
                require(current.get(path) == identity, f"immutable base file changed/deleted: {path}")
        elif path == 'tests/test_p4_3a_workflow_capability_census.py':
            from scripts import audit_phase_a_pass_a_tests_source_successor as census_source
            predecessor = census_source.historical_census_test_source()
            row = census_source._pytest_restoration_receipt()['source_forward'][path]
            require(
                identity == {"mode": "100644", "git_blob_sha1": row['before']['git_blob_sha1']}
                and current.get(path) == {"mode": "100644", "git_blob_sha1": row['after']['git_blob_sha1']},
                "Checkpoint-E census test predecessor/successor identity drift",
            )
            pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path] = row['before']['git_blob_sha1']
            if path in value["scan_paths"]:
                pass1_forward_predecessor_sources[path] = predecessor
        elif path == TESTS_WORKFLOW:
            # Checkpoint-E V1 is a historical source view. Authenticate the
            # present eight-shard workflow and A2 corpus first, then project
            # only its exact frozen predecessor into this historical scan.
            from scripts import audit_phase_a_pass_a_tests_source_successor as tests_source
            from scripts import audit_tests_shard_balance_successor as tests_shards

            predecessor = tests_source.historical_workflow_source()
            require(
                identity == {"mode": "100644", "git_blob_sha1": tests_shards.BEFORE["git_blob_sha1"]}
                and current.get(path) == {
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "git_blob_sha1": tests_shards.AFTER["git_blob_sha1"],
                }
                and predecessor == tests_shards.read_blob(tests_shards.FIXTURE)
                and tests_shards.identity(predecessor) == tests_shards.BEFORE,
                "Checkpoint-E Tests workflow predecessor/successor identity drift",
            )
            pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path] = tests_shards.BEFORE["git_blob_sha1"]
            if path in value["scan_paths"]:
                pass1_forward_predecessor_sources[path] = predecessor
        else:
            require(current.get(path) == identity, f"immutable base file changed/deleted: {path}")
    # Git can be clean while the working tree has edits. Verify inspected source
    # through Git's declared filters, without normalizing arbitrary evidence.
    hashed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "hash-object", "--stdin-paths"],
        input="".join(json.dumps(path, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for path in value["scan_paths"]).encode(),
        capture_output=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.decode().splitlines()
    require(len(hashed) == len(value["scan_paths"]), "worktree filtered hash inventory incomplete")
    latest_a2 = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    latest_a2_paths = {row["path"] for row in latest_a2["source_identities"]}
    for path in PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS:
        require(
            path in latest_a2_paths,
            "Pass-A preserved workflow is not authenticated by current A2: " + path,
        )
    from scripts import audit_app_01a_local_shell as app01a
    successor_paths, successor = app01a.authenticated_historical_paths()
    for path, actual in zip(value["scan_paths"], hashed):
        from scripts import audit_run_02a_pre_durable_share_send as prerequisite
        if path in prerequisite.TRANSPORT_PREDECESSORS:
            predecessor = prerequisite.historical_transport_bytes(path, root=ROOT)
            actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(predecessor)).encode() + b"\0" + predecessor).hexdigest()
        from scripts import audit_core_01d_authority_reachability_review_a as review
        if path in review.FRESH_HOLDOUT_20261014_PREDECESSOR_SOURCES:
            predecessor = _fresh_holdout_20261014_source(path)
            actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(predecessor)).encode() + b"\0" + predecessor).hexdigest()
        if path in FRESH_HOLDOUT_20261014_TEST_TREE_IDENTITIES:
            actual = _fresh_holdout_20261014_test_identity(path)["git_blob_sha1"]
        if path in successor_paths and path in successor["base_identities"]:
            actual = successor["base_identities"][path]["git_blob_sha1"]
        if path in INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS:
            _authenticate_incident_20261010_current_sources()
            actual = INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS[path]
        if path in a2.HISTORICAL_TEST_BLOBS:
            actual = a2.HISTORICAL_TEST_BLOBS[path]
        from scripts.core_01d_historical_source import identities
        from scripts import audit_data_01c_restore_portability as d5
        if path in identities() or path in d5.snapshot()["sources"]:
            inspected = read(path)
            actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(inspected)).encode() + b"\0" + inspected).hexdigest()
        from scripts import audit_core_01d_retained_workflow_status_v2 as retained_status_v2
        if path in supporting_source_blobs and path in retained_status_v2.HISTORICAL_SUPPORTING_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS:
            # _authenticate_pr119_release_only_workflow_forward verified both

        if path in PASS_A_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_BLOBS:
            # Current bytes are independently authenticated by A2 above; this
            # scan projects the separately pinned Pass-A historical identity.
            actual = PASS_A_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_BLOBS[path]
        if path in PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS:
            # These current workflow/test successors are also authenticated
            # by the complete latest A2 inventory above; preserve the exact
            # immutable Pass-A base identity for this historical scan.
            actual = PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS[path]
        if path in pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs:
            # The source was independently authenticated by its exact
            # Pass-A/V284/V300 transition in the immutable base comparison.
            actual = pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path]
        expected_blob = (
            audit_after if path == HISTORICAL_AUDIT
            else fresh_workflow_after_blob if path == fresh_workflow_path and fresh_workflow_after_blob
            else supporting_source_blobs[path] if path in supporting_source_blobs
            else PASS_A_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_BLOBS[path] if path in PASS_A_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_BLOBS
            else PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS[path] if path in PASS_A_PRESERVED_A2_BASE_SOURCE_BLOBS
            else INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS[path] if path in INCIDENT_20261010_PREDECESSOR_BLOBS
            else pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs[path] if path in pass1_forward_predecessor_blobs
            else value["files"][path]["git_blob_sha1"]
        )
        require(actual == expected_blob, f"worktree source differs: {path}")
    require(value["workflow_tree_sha1"] == "134cdd8bfa54488770f562c93571e46ac84a8187", "immutable V1 workflow tree changed")
    if include_scan_source_predecessors:
        return value, pass1_forward_predecessor_sources
    return value

def parity_evidence():
    rows = []
    for clock in ("09:00", "22:59", "23:00"):
        now = datetime.fromisoformat(f"2026-10-01T{clock}:00+00:00")
        scheduled = resolve_workflow_request(event_name="schedule", now=now)
        require((scheduled.authority_profile, scheduled.mode, scheduled.target_legs,
                 scheduled.bookie, scheduled.create_share_code, scheduled.place_wager) ==
                ("MAIN", "main_application", 20, "sportybet", False, False), "scheduled MAIN semantics changed")
        for suffix in ("scope=today", "scope=three-day", "dates=20261001", "dates=20261002,20261003"):
            result = comment.resolve_comment("/athena-shadow target=20 " + suffix, now=now)
            representable = clock != "23:00" or suffix == "dates=20261002,20261003"
            require((result.compatibility_status == comment.REPRESENTABLE) is representable, "date-shifting parity claim")
            if representable:
                # Preserve legacy intent for the parity proof. This is parsing,
                # not authority to create a code, and is never executed.
                request = parse_explicit_request(
                    days=",".join(datetime.strptime(day, "%Y%m%d").date().isoformat()
                                  for day in result.legacy_utc_resolved_dates),
                    target_legs=20, profile="shadow", create_share_code=True, now=now,
                )
                require(canonical_json_bytes(request) == result.canonical_request_bytes, "legacy request byte parity differs")
            else:
                require(result.canonical_request_bytes is None and result.canonical_request_sha256 is None, "fabricated canonical request for unrepresentable UTC intent")
            rows.append({"clock_utc": now.isoformat(), "legacy_input": suffix,
                         "status": result.compatibility_status, "legacy_dates": list(result.legacy_utc_resolved_dates),
                         "canonical_request_sha256": result.canonical_request_sha256,
                         "delivery_compatibility_intent": True, "date_shift": False,
                         "execution_authorized_by_test": False})
    return rows

def reachability(path, name, artifact_names, texts):
    identifiers = sorted({path, Path(path).name, name, *artifact_names})
    matches = []
    for source, text in texts.items():
        if source == path:
            continue
        lines = []
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            hits = [term for term in identifiers if term and term in line]
            if hits:
                lines.append({"line": number, "identifiers": hits})
        if lines:
            matches.append({"path": source, "matches": lines,
                            "classification": "DOCS" if source.startswith("docs/") else
                            "TEST" if source.startswith("tests/") else "SOURCE_OR_WORKFLOW"})
    return {"scan_basis": "EXACT_BASE_TRACKED_SOURCE_NOT_ZERO_GREP_RETIREMENT_PROOF",
            "matches": matches, "dynamic_subprocess_reachability": "NOT_PROVEN_FOR_RETIREMENT",
            "retirement_reachability_pass": False}


def build_matrix(base, history, historical_source_predecessors):
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_checkpoint_e_completion_v2 as pass_a_v2
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    from scripts import audit_phase_a_pass_a_tests_source_successor as tests_source

    allowed_predecessor_paths = (
        a2.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS
        | a2.E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS
        | pass_a_v2.PASS_A_V2_AUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS
        | {TESTS_WORKFLOW, tests_source.CENSUS_TEST}
    )
    require(
        type(historical_source_predecessors) is dict
        and set(historical_source_predecessors) <= allowed_predecessor_paths,
        "historical reachability scan received an unapproved source predecessor",
    )
    for path, raw in historical_source_predecessors.items():
        expected = base["files"].get(path)
        require(
            path in base["scan_paths"]
            and expected is not None
            and expected.get("mode") == "100644"
            and type(raw) is bytes,
            "historical reachability scan predecessor is outside the immutable source inventory: " + path,
        )
        if path == TESTS_WORKFLOW:
            require(
                raw == tests_source.historical_workflow_source(),
                "Checkpoint-E Tests workflow predecessor was not independently authenticated",
            )
        if path == tests_source.CENSUS_TEST:
            require(
                raw == tests_source.historical_census_test_source(),
                "Checkpoint-E census predecessor was not independently authenticated",
            )
        blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        require(
            blob == expected.get("git_blob_sha1"),
            "historical reachability scan predecessor differs from the immutable source inventory: " + path,
        )
    texts = {path: read(path).decode("utf-8") for path in base["scan_paths"]}
    texts.update({path: raw.decode("utf-8") for path, raw in historical_source_predecessors.items()})
    texts[HISTORICAL_AUDIT] = read(HISTORICAL_AUDIT_FIXTURE).decode("utf-8")
    old = strict(read("artifacts/architecture/p4_3_workflow_capability_matrix_v1.json"))
    old_rows = {row["workflow_path"]: row for row in old["workflow_rows"]}
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(p for p in base["files"] if p.startswith(".github/workflows/") and p.endswith((".yml", ".yaml"))):
        # This matrix reconstructs the immutable Checkpoint-E V1 view, so an
        # authenticated predecessor is used for both reachability and YAML
        # metadata. Current workflow authority is validated separately against
        # the exact current tree and A2/shard-successor evidence.
        raw = (historical_source_predecessors[path]
               if path in historical_source_predecessors else read(path))
        doc = yaml.load(raw, Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
        require(type(doc) is dict and type(doc.get("on")) is dict, f"unsupported trigger shape: {path}")
        name = doc.get("name", Path(path).stem)
        steps = census._steps(doc)
        uploads, downloads = census._artifacts(steps)
        artifacts = sorted({row["name"] for row in uploads if row["name"]})
        historical = old_rows.get(path, {})
        family = historical.get("successor_family", "RETAIN_PENDING_AUDIT")
        purpose = historical.get("purpose", "Newer workflow; explicit retained capability pending full successor proof")
        if path == ".github/workflows/athena-ingest.yml":
            family, purpose = "ATHENA_INGEST", "Canonical reviewed ingest transport (not a SHADOW run successor)"
        if path == ".github/workflows/native-runtime-tests.yml":
            family, purpose = "TESTS", "Offline native Windows runtime validation"
        status = "CANONICAL_SUPPORTED" if path in {CANONICAL, ".github/workflows/tests.yml", ".github/workflows/athena-ingest.yml", ".github/workflows/native-runtime-tests.yml"} else "EXPLICIT_RETAINED_COMPATIBILITY"
        reason = "Canonical family retained unchanged" if status == "CANONICAL_SUPPORTED" else (
            "Unique protected research/diagnostic/history/bridge capability; no exact successor or full retirement proof in C4"
        )
        if historical.get("date_hardcoded"):
            status = "HISTORICAL_ONLY"
            reason = "Frozen dated evidence workflow, not a supported current football run; dependent evidence consumers and retention require individual retirement proof"
        refs = reachability(path, name, artifacts, texts)
        surfaces = []
        for trigger, detail in sorted(doc["on"].items()):
            canonical_run = path == CANONICAL
            shadow = path == SHADOW
            main = canonical_run and trigger == "schedule"
            surface = {
                "trigger_kind": trigger, "event_details": detail,
                "supported_status": status, "purpose": purpose,
                "authority_profile": "MAIN" if main else "MAIN_OR_SHADOW_EXPLICIT" if canonical_run else "SHADOW" if shadow else "UNKNOWN_NOT_RECLASSIFIED_BY_CENSUS",
                "acquisition_authority": False if main else "EXPLICIT_SHADOW_ONLY" if canonical_run else True if shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "delivery_authority": False if main else "EXPLICIT_CREATE_SHARE_CODE_INTENT" if canonical_run else "LEGACY_IMPLICIT_TRUE_RETAINED_NOT_EXECUTED_IN_C4" if shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "wager_authority": False if canonical_run or shadow else "UNKNOWN",
                "request_parser_owner": "services/athena_run_workflow_request.py" if canonical_run else "services/athena_shadow_issue_comment_compatibility.py" if shadow and trigger == "issue_comment" else path,
                "date_policy_owner": "services/athena_run_request_parser.py" if canonical_run else "domain/current_shadow_fixture_date_request.py" if shadow else "WORKFLOW_SPECIFIC_NOT_MIGRATED",
                "date_timezone_semantics": "Africa/Lagos concrete date frozen once" if canonical_run else "UTC YYYYMMDD rolling today..today+6; no shift" if shadow else "WORKFLOW_SPECIFIC_NOT_PROVEN_EQUIVALENT",
                "target_semantics": "1..50 maximum desired legs; truthful shortfall; schedule=20" if canonical_run or shadow else "WORKFLOW_SPECIFIC",
                "provider_bookie_semantics": "sportybet" if canonical_run or shadow else "WORKFLOW_SPECIFIC",
                "notification_behavior": "NONE" if canonical_run else "EXPLICIT_RETAINED_SECONDARY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE" if shadow else "WORKFLOW_SPECIFIC_UNCHANGED",
                "canonical_successor_path": CANONICAL if canonical_run or shadow else historical.get("successor_workflow_path"),
                "successor_request_parity": "CURRENT_CANONICAL_OWNER" if canonical_run else "BLOCKED_UTC_DATE_AND_DELIVERY_INTENT" if shadow else "NOT_PROVEN",
                "successor_authority_parity": "CURRENT_CANONICAL_OWNER" if canonical_run else "NOT_PROVEN_NO_AUTHORITY_DELTA_CLAIM",
                "successor_artifact_parity": "CANONICAL_ROLES_VERIFIED_C2_AND_ACCEPTED_LGA" if canonical_run else "LEGACY_READ_ONLY_COMPATIBILITY_NOT_CUTOVER" if shadow else "NOT_PROVEN",
                "successor_notification_parity": "NO_CANONICAL_NOTIFICATION" if canonical_run else "RETAINED_NOT_MIGRATED",
                "retained_reason": reason, "deletion_eligible": False,
                "deletion_blockers": ["FULL_14_POINT_RETIREMENT_PROOF_NOT_ESTABLISHED", "DYNAMIC_REACHABILITY_AND_DURABLE_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_NOT_PROVEN"],
            }
            if shadow and trigger == "schedule":
                surface["successor_request_parity"] = "09Z_DATE_PARITY_ONLY_NO_REVIEWED_MULTI_PROFILE_SCHEDULE"
                surface["retained_reason"] = "Preserve MAIN-only canonical schedule and single-request/run artifact identity; multi-profile schedule/archive ownership needs explicit reviewed design; legacy implicit delivery is not analysis-only byte parity"
            if shadow and trigger == "issue_comment":
                surface["retained_reason"] = "Exact #276/owner grammars retained; UTC 23Z requests can be unrepresentable; legacy true delivery intent cannot silently become false; no implicit hybrid execution"
            surfaces.append(surface)
        rows.append({
            "workflow_path": path, "workflow_name": name, "workflow_family": family,
            "git_blob_sha1": base["files"][path]["git_blob_sha1"], "source_sha256": sha(raw),
            "supported_status": status, "purpose": purpose, "trigger_surfaces": surfaces,
            "artifact_names": artifacts, "artifact_uploads": uploads, "artifact_downloads": downloads,
            "canonical_artifact_roles": list(roles.ROLE_IDS) if path == CANONICAL else [],
            "historical_restore_role": "PERSISTENT_FIXTURE_IDENTITY_STATE" if path == SHADOW else "DURABLE_HISTORY_PRIME" if path.endswith("current-shadow-history-cache-prime.yml") else None,
            "supported_current_runtime_root": path == CANONICAL or historical.get("supported_runtime_root", False),
            "date_hardcoded_historical_evidence": historical.get("date_hardcoded", False),
            "current_callers_and_references": refs,
            "last_relevant_historical_runs": history[path],
            "retained_reason": reason, "deletion_eligible": False,
            "rollback": {"commit": BASE, "path": path, **base["files"][path]},
            "evidence_references": historical.get("evidence_references", []) + [BASE_PATH, HISTORY_PATH],
        })
    return seal({"schema_version": 1, "policy_id": MATRIX_POLICY_ID, "base_main_sha": BASE,
                 "source_scan_input_sha256": BASE_INPUT_SHA, "history_input_sha256": HISTORY_INPUT_SHA,
                 "workflow_count": len(rows), "trigger_surface_count": sum(len(row["trigger_surfaces"]) for row in rows),
                 "workflow_rows": rows, "retired_in_this_pr": [],
                 "unknown_means_not_proven": True, "retirement_authority_from_matrix": False})


def checkpoint_status(criteria):
    require(type(criteria) is dict and criteria and all(type(v) is bool for v in criteria.values()), "criteria must be explicit booleans")
    blockers = sorted(key for key, value in criteria.items() if not value)
    return ("COMPLETE" if not blockers else "INCOMPLETE"), blockers


def validate_retirement_row(row):
    require(row.get("deletion_eligible") is True, "retirement row not eligible")
    require(row.get("last_relevant_historical_runs", {}).get("last_successful"), "missing last successful run evidence")
    require(row.get("rollback"), "missing rollback identity")
    checklist = row.get("retirement_checklist", {})
    require(set(checklist) == set(range(1, 15)) and all(v is True for v in checklist.values()), "full 14-point retirement checklist required")
    require(row.get("supported_callers_remaining") == [] and row.get("required_restore_dependencies") == [], "retired workflow still reachable/required")


def validate_documents(matrix, receipt):
    require(matrix.get("canonical_sha256") == self_sha(matrix) and receipt.get("canonical_sha256") == self_sha(receipt), "matrix/receipt self hash mismatch")
    rows = matrix["workflow_rows"]
    paths = [row["workflow_path"] for row in rows]
    live = sorted(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for path in (ROOT / ".github/workflows").iterdir() if path.suffix in {".yml", ".yaml"})
    require(paths == live and len(set(paths)) == len(paths) == matrix["workflow_count"], "live workflow inventory count/coverage mismatch")
    for row in rows:
        doc = yaml.load(read(row["workflow_path"]), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
        surfaces = row["trigger_surfaces"]
        require([surface["trigger_kind"] for surface in surfaces] == sorted(doc["on"]), "trigger-specific row coverage mismatch")
        require(row["supported_status"] in ALLOWED_STATUS, "workflow lacks successor/retained status")
        for surface in surfaces:
            require(surface["supported_status"] in ALLOWED_STATUS and surface["retained_reason"], "supported surface missing exact retained/successor status")
            require(surface["deletion_eligible"] is False, "unsupported deletion eligibility claim")
    require(sum(len(row["trigger_surfaces"]) for row in rows) == matrix["trigger_surface_count"], "trigger count mismatch")
    require(not any(row["supported_current_runtime_root"] and row["date_hardcoded_historical_evidence"] for row in rows),
            "supported current runtime depends on date-hardcoded workflow")
    status, blockers = checkpoint_status(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"])
    require(receipt["checkpoint_e_status"] == receipt["p4_4_status"] == status and receipt["remaining_blocker_ids"] == blockers, "Checkpoint E COMPLETE with false mandatory criterion")
    require(receipt["workflow_matrix_sha256"] == matrix["canonical_sha256"], "matrix receipt binding mismatch")
    require(receipt["retired_workflows"] == matrix["retired_in_this_pr"] == [], "retirement not proven in this checkpoint")
    accepted = receipt["accepted_lg_a"]
    require((accepted["run_id"], accepted["exact_head"], accepted["artifact_id"], accepted["artifact_name"], accepted["local_zip_sha256"], accepted["attempt"], accepted["terminal"]) ==
            (36860297707, BASE, 11163921301, "athena-run-36860297707", ZIP_SHA, 1, "RESEARCH_SHADOW_PORTFOLIO_READY_WITH_SHORTFALL"), "accepted LG-A run/head/artifact mismatch")
    require(receipt["historical_failed_lg_a"]["restore_eligible"] is False and
            receipt["historical_failed_lg_a"]["disposition"] == "IMMUTABLE_FAILED_NON_RETRYABLE", "failed producer relabeled eligible/successful")
    require(receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["grammars"] == [comment.SCOPE_GRAMMAR, comment.EXPLICIT_DATES_GRAMMAR] and
            receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["issue"] == 276 and
            receipt["issue_comment_disposition"]["owner_guard"] == "github.repository_owner", "issue-comment grammar/admission drift")
    require(receipt["notification_disposition"]["legacy"] == "EXPLICIT_RETAINED_SECONDARY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE" and
            receipt["notification_disposition"]["security_integrity_failure"] == "FAIL_CLOSED" and
            receipt["notification_disposition"]["ordinary_transport_failure"] == "EMAIL_FAILED_WARNING_EXIT_ZERO", "notification authority/failure drift")
    require(all(case["date_shift"] is False for case in receipt["date_schedule_disposition"]["parity_evidence"]), "date-shifting parity claim")
    require(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"]["scheduled_shadow_canonical_ownership_proven_preserving_main"] is False,
            "no reviewed multi-profile scheduled SHADOW implementation exists")
    unknown = any(surface["acquisition_authority"] == "UNKNOWN" for row in rows for surface in row["trigger_surfaces"])
    require(receipt["checkpoint_criteria"]["all_retained_workflow_authority_and_dynamic_reachability_review_complete"] is (not unknown), "unknown authority treated as proven")
    require(all(value == 0 and type(value) is int for value in receipt["live_side_effect_counts"].values()) and
            all(value == 0 and type(value) is int for value in receipt["semantic_delta"].values()), "live/semantic authority expansion")

def authenticate_pass4_e3_source_predecessor(path: str, a2=None, latest=None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Bind one exact V1 predecessor fixture to the current A2 successor."""
    if a2 is None:
        from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    descriptor = PASS4_E3_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS.get(path)
    policy.require(descriptor is not None,
                   "Pass-4 source path has no exact E3 predecessor authority: " + path)
    fixture_path, expected_blob, expected_sha, expected_size = descriptor
    for relative in (path, fixture_path):
        candidate = ROOT / relative
        policy.require(candidate.is_file()
                       and not any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in (candidate, *candidate.parents)),
                       "Pass-4 E3 predecessor requires regular source/fixture: " + relative)
        a2._e3_path_stat(relative, label="Pass-4 E3 predecessor")
    scope = a2._active_a2_derivation_scope()
    if scope is not None:
        state = a2._load_scoped_a2_source_state(scope)
        if latest is None:
            latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
        policy.require(state is not None and type(latest) is dict
                       and state.get("latest_sha256") == latest.get("canonical_sha256"),
                       "Pass-4 predecessor lacks the active A2 source-forward derivation")
    elif latest is None:
        latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    current_rows = {row["path"]: row for row in latest["source_identities"]}
    current = a2.lf((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
    head_blob = a2.git("rev-parse", "HEAD:" + path).decode("ascii").strip()
    worktree_blob = a2.git("hash-object", path).decode("ascii").strip()
    policy.require(current_rows.get(path, {}).get("lf_source_sha256")
                   == hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()
                   and head_blob == worktree_blob,
                   "current Pass-4 E3 source differs from authenticated A2 successor: " + path)
    fixture = a2.lf((ROOT / fixture_path).read_bytes())
    fixture_blob = hashlib.sha1(
        b"blob " + str(len(fixture)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + fixture
    ).hexdigest()
    tracked_blob = a2.git("rev-parse", "HEAD:" + fixture_path).decode("ascii").strip()
    policy.require(len(fixture) == expected_size
                   and hashlib.sha256(fixture).hexdigest() == expected_sha
                   and fixture_blob == expected_blob == tracked_blob,
                   "Pass-4 E3 predecessor fixture identity drift: " + fixture_path)
    return expected_blob, expected_sha

def authenticate_notification_without_transport() -> bool:
    """Authenticate C3 bytes/guards without invoking even a mocked sender."""
    from scripts import audit_core_01c_notification_comment_compatibility as notification
    value = policy.roles.strict_json(notification.tracked(notification.RECEIPT_PATH))
    policy.require(value["canonical_sha256"] ==
                   "d89c38790bb0dc36a052e865bf2e5bd17411d0089ec4797b5aa145f40705ffc8"
                   == evolution.canonical_sha256(value), "sealed C3 notification identity drift")
    for path in notification.SOURCE_PATHS:
        policy.require(evolution.source_identity(notification.tracked(path)) == value["source_identities"][path],
                       f"notification historical source identity drift: {path}")
    notification.verify_workflow_authority(notification.tracked(notification.BEFORE_FIXTURE),
                                           notification.tracked(notification.WORKFLOW))
    facts = value["notification"]
    return (facts["status"] == "EXPLICIT_RETAINED_SECONDARY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE"
            and facts["integrity_security_failure"] == "FAIL_CLOSED"
            and facts["transport_failure"] == "EMAIL_FAILED_WARNING_EXIT_ZERO"
            and facts["business_receipt_mutation"] is False and facts["core_rerun"] is False)


def status_from_criteria(criteria: dict) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    policy.require(set(criteria) == set(CRITERIA)
                   and all(type(flag) is bool for flag in criteria.values()),
                   "all 19 explicit boolean criteria are mandatory")
    blockers = [key for key in CRITERIA if criteria[key] is not True]
    return ("INCOMPLETE" if blockers else "COMPLETE"), blockers


def _build_receipt_uncached() -> dict:

def authenticate_pass4_e3_source_predecessor(path: str, a2=None, latest=None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Bind one exact V1 predecessor fixture to the current A2 successor."""
    if a2 is None:
        from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    descriptor = PASS4_E3_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS.get(path)
    policy.require(descriptor is not None,
                   "Pass-4 source path has no exact E3 predecessor authority: " + path)
    fixture_path, expected_blob, expected_sha, expected_size = descriptor
    for relative in (path, fixture_path):
        candidate = ROOT / relative
        policy.require(candidate.is_file()
                       and not any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in (candidate, *candidate.parents)),
                       "Pass-4 E3 predecessor requires regular source/fixture: " + relative)
        a2._e3_path_stat(relative, label="Pass-4 E3 predecessor")
    if latest is None:
        latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    current_rows = {row["path"]: row for row in latest["source_identities"]}
    current = a2.lf((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
    head_blob = a2.git("rev-parse", "HEAD:" + path).decode("ascii").strip()
    worktree_blob = a2.git("hash-object", path).decode("ascii").strip()
    policy.require(current_rows.get(path, {}).get("lf_source_sha256")
                   == hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()
                   and head_blob == worktree_blob,
                   "current Pass-4 E3 source differs from authenticated A2 successor: " + path)
    fixture = a2.lf((ROOT / fixture_path).read_bytes())
    fixture_blob = hashlib.sha1(
        b"blob " + str(len(fixture)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + fixture
    ).hexdigest()
    tracked_blob = a2.git("rev-parse", "HEAD:" + fixture_path).decode("ascii").strip()
    policy.require(len(fixture) == expected_size
                   and hashlib.sha256(fixture).hexdigest() == expected_sha
                   and fixture_blob == expected_blob == tracked_blob,
                   "Pass-4 E3 predecessor fixture identity drift: " + fixture_path)
    return expected_blob, expected_sha

def status_from_criteria(criteria: dict) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    policy.require(set(criteria) == set(CRITERIA)
                   and all(type(flag) is bool for flag in criteria.values()),
                   "all 19 explicit boolean criteria are mandatory")
    blockers = [key for key in CRITERIA if criteria[key] is not True]
    return ("INCOMPLETE" if blockers else "COMPLETE"), blockers

def authenticate_pass_a_e3_compat_predecessors(a2,latest):

 blobs={}
 for path,(fixture,expected_blob,expected_sha,expected_size) in PASS_A_E3_COMPAT_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS.items():
  for relative in (path,fixture):
   a2._e3_path_stat(relative,label='Pass-A E3 audit source')
  current=a2.lf((ROOT/path).read_bytes())
  row=identities.get(path,{})
  head_blob=a2.git('rev-parse','HEAD:'+path).decode().strip()
  worktree_blob=a2.git('hash-object',path).decode().strip()
  review.require(hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()==row.get('lf_source_sha256')
                 and head_blob==worktree_blob,
                 'current Pass-A E3 audit source differs from authenticated A2: '+path)
  predecessor=a2.lf((ROOT/fixture).read_bytes())
  fixture_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(predecessor)).encode()+b'\0'+predecessor).hexdigest()
  tracked_fixture=a2.git('rev-parse','HEAD:'+fixture).decode().strip()
  review.require(len(predecessor)==expected_size
                 and hashlib.sha256(predecessor).hexdigest()==expected_sha
                 and fixture_blob==expected_blob==tracked_fixture,
                 'Pass-A E3 audit predecessor differs from its exact base source: '+path)
  if path in PASS_A_V2_AUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_PREDECESSORS:
   review.require(v2_rows.get(path,{}).get('lf_source_sha256')==expected_sha,
                  'Pass-A test predecessor differs from immutable A2 V2 source identity: '+path)
  blobs[path]=expected_blob

def resolve_historical_source_transition(path, *, expected_generation):
    """Resolve one path only through its explicitly requested A2 generation."""
    require(type(path) is str, "historical source path must be exact text")
    require(type(expected_generation) is int,
            "historical source generation must be an exact integer")
    if expected_generation == E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION:
        paths = E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_V284_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS
        transitions = E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_TRANSITIONS
        expected_count = 11
    elif expected_generation == E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION:
        paths = E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS
        transitions = E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_TRANSITIONS
        expected_count = 8
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unsupported historical source transition generation")
    require(len(paths) == expected_count and set(transitions) == set(paths),
            "historical source transition table has an unreviewed path set")
    require(not (set(E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_V284_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS)
                 & set(E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_PATHS)),
            "historical source path is ambiguous across V284 and V300")
    require(path in paths,
            "path is not authorized by the requested historical source generation: " + repr(path))
    if expected_generation == E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION:
        fixture_paths = [row.get("predecessor_fixture")
                         for row in transitions.values() if type(row) is dict]
        require(set(fixture_paths) == set(E3_PASS_A_SOURCE_FORWARD_FIXTURE_PATHS)
                and len(fixture_paths) == len(set(fixture_paths)),
                "V300 predecessor fixture table has a duplicate or unreviewed path")
    return transitions[path]

def _e3_port02c_b6_v377_source_extension(chain, generation):
    """Append the current B6 source after its unchanged V284 successor."""
    predecessor_generation = 376
    path = "scripts/audit_core_01d_port02c_trigger_authority_b6.py"
    require(type(chain) is list and len(chain) >= predecessor_generation
            and type(generation) is int and generation >= 377,
            "E3 B6 V377 source successor requires the exact V376 chain")
    predecessor_path, predecessor = chain[predecessor_generation - 1]
    require(predecessor_path == inventory_generation_path(predecessor_generation)
            and predecessor.get("generation") == predecessor_generation
            and predecessor.get("schema_version") == predecessor_generation
            and predecessor.get("canonical_sha256")
                == RCV_RECOVERY_V376_SOURCE_PREDECESSOR_SHA256,
            "E3 B6 V377 source predecessor path or generation drift")
    transition = resolve_historical_source_transition(
        path, expected_generation=E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION,
    )
    predecessor_rows = {
        row["path"]: row["lf_source_sha256"]
        for row in predecessor.get("source_identities", [])
        if type(row) is dict and type(row.get("path")) is str
    }
    previous_lf = predecessor_rows.get(path)
    require(previous_lf == transition["successor_lf_source_sha256"],
            "E3 B6 V377 predecessor does not preserve the exact V284 successor")

    candidate = _e3_path_stat(path, label="B6 V377 current source")
    try:
        raw, identity = _read_tracked_head_blob_scoped(ROOT, path)
        worktree_raw = candidate.read_bytes()
    except (OSError, SourceIdentityError) as error:
        raise AssertionError("E3 B6 V377 current source identity is unavailable") from error
    normalized = raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
    worktree_normalized = worktree_raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
    require(worktree_normalized == normalized
            and identity.git_blob_sha1 != transition["successor_git_blob_sha1"],
            "E3 B6 V377 source is unchanged or differs from exact tracked bytes")
    entry = git("ls-tree", "-z", "HEAD", "--", path)
    require(bool(entry), "E3 B6 V377 source is not tracked at HEAD")
    try:
        metadata, tree_path = entry.rstrip(b"\0").split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, blob = metadata.decode("ascii").split(" ")
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise AssertionError("E3 B6 V377 HEAD tree entry is malformed") from error
    require(tree_path.decode("utf-8") == path and mode == "100644"
            and kind == "blob" and blob == identity.git_blob_sha1,
            "E3 B6 V377 source mode/path/blob identity drift")
    return {
        "path": path,
        "generation": 377,
        "predecessor_inventory": {
            "path": predecessor_path,
            "canonical_sha256": predecessor["canonical_sha256"],
            "generation": predecessor_generation,
            "rewritten": False,
        },
        "previous_successor": {
            "generation": predecessor_generation,
            "canonical_sha256": predecessor["canonical_sha256"],
            "git_blob_sha1": transition["successor_git_blob_sha1"],
            "lf_source_sha256": previous_lf,
            "rewritten": False,
        },
        "successor": {
            "git_blob_sha1": identity.git_blob_sha1,
            "lf_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(normalized).hexdigest(),
            "git_mode": "100644",
        },
        "reason_type": "RCV_RECOVERY_B6_SOURCE_FORWARD_V377",
        "reason": "Append-only B6 source identity after the unchanged V1-V376 chain and exact V284 predecessor projection",
        "authority_granted": False,

    }
