def authenticated_historical_a2_v9() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Authenticate latest corpus first, then exact immutable B7 generation.

    A later local-shell inventory is not a rewrite of the B7 review. A broken
    latest generation still fails closed; this is never a fallback selector.
    """
    boundary.authenticate_inventory()
    value = boundary.read_generation(boundary.inventory_generation_path(9))
    require(value.get("canonical_sha256") == A2_V9_SHA,
            "immutable B7 A2 V9 identity drift")
    return value


def build_receipt() -> dict[str, Any]:
    parent = completion_v9.validate_receipt()
    require(parent.get("canonical_sha256") == COMPLETION_V9_SHA,
            "immutable Completion V9 identity drift")
    inherited = parent["unreviewed_authority_surfaces"]
    require(len(inherited) == 1
            and {(row["workflow_path"], row["trigger_kind"]) for row in inherited} == {TARGET},
            "B7 predecessor must contain exactly the Win-Either-Half pull_request surface")
    require(parent["checkpoint_criteria"]["all_retained_workflow_authority_and_dynamic_reachability_review_complete"] is False
            and parent["checkpoint_criteria"]["no_unknown_current_artifact_or_notification_authority"] is False,
            "B7 predecessor criteria 11/14 must both remain false")
    require(parent["remaining_blocker_ids"] == [
        "all_retained_workflow_authority_and_dynamic_reachability_review_complete",
        "no_unknown_current_artifact_or_notification_authority",
    ], "B7 predecessor blocker set drift")
    require(parent["checkpoint_e_status"] == parent["p4_4_status"] == "INCOMPLETE",
            "B7 predecessor must be incomplete")
    b6_receipt = b6.validate_receipt()
    require(b6_receipt.get("canonical_sha256") == B6_RECEIPT_SHA,
            "immutable B6 receipt identity drift")
    inventory = validate_source_inventory()
    a2_current = authenticated_historical_a2_v9()
    require(a2_current.get("generation") == 9,
            "B7 requires its immutable A2 generation V9")
    require(a2_current.get("predecessor_inventory") == {
        "path": A2_V8_PATH,
        "canonical_sha256": A2_V8_SHA,
        "generation": 8,
        "rewritten": False,
    }, "A2 V9 predecessor binding is not exact V8")
    contract = _workflow_contract()
    network_scan = _assert_no_application_network_imports()
    domain = _domain_authority_contract()
    invariants = _architecture_invariants()
    row = _review_row(contract, domain, network_scan)
    require(row["status"] == "RESOLVED" and row["blocker"] is None,
            "B7 final row is not fully resolved")
    require(ZERO_ACTIONS == {key: 0 for key in ZERO_ACTIONS},
            "B7 live actions must remain zero")
    return boundary.seal({
        "schema_version": 1,
        "policy_id": POLICY_ID,
        "repository": "Thabearr/ATHENA",
        "master_issue": 337,

            "a2_generation_8": {"path": A2_V8_PATH, "canonical_sha256": A2_V8_SHA, "generation": 8, "rewritten": False},
            "a2_generation_9": {"path": boundary.inventory_generation_path(9),
                                "canonical_sha256": a2_current["canonical_sha256"],
                                "generation": 9,

def validate_receipt(value: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = boundary.read(RECEIPT_PATH) if value is None else value
    require((ROOT / RECEIPT_PATH).read_bytes() == boundary.canonical(value),
            "B7 receipt is not canonical")
    expected = build_receipt()
    require(value == expected, "B7 receipt differs from exact source and Completion V9 overlay")
    require(value["target_count"] == value["resolved_target_count"] == 1
            and value["partial_target_count"] == 0
            and value["global_unknown_before"] == 1
            and value["global_unknown_after"] == 0
            and value["remaining_unreviewed_surfaces"] == [],
            "B7 final scope/count derivation drift")
    require(value["criterion_11"] is True and value["criterion_14"] is True
            and value["checkpoint_e_status"] == value["p4_4_status"] == "COMPLETE",
            "B7 must close criteria 11/14 and Checkpoint E/P4.4")
    require(value["actions"] == ZERO_ACTIONS,
            "B7 performed or claimed a prohibited live action")
    return value


def audit() -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = validate_receipt()
    return {
        "result": "PASS",
        "receipt_sha256": value["canonical_sha256"],
        "source_inventory_sha256": value["source_inventory"]["canonical_sha256"],
        "target_count": 1,

    """Exact callable identity for the pure V376 JSON validator inputs."""
    global_bindings = (
        safe.canonical.__globals__.get("json"),
        safe.canonical_digest.__globals__.get("canonical"),
        safe.canonical_digest.__globals__.get("hashlib"),
    )
    functions = (
        safe.canonical,
        safe.canonical_digest,
        json.loads,
        json.dumps,
        json.JSONDecoder,
        json.JSONDecoder.__init__,
        json.JSONDecoder.decode,
        json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode,
        json.JSONEncoder,
        json.JSONEncoder.__init__,
        json.JSONEncoder.encode,
        json.JSONEncoder.iterencode,
        hashlib.sha256,
        marshal.dumps,
        marshal.loads,
    )
    identities = []
    for function in functions:
        code = getattr(function, "__code__", None)
        identities.append((
            id(function),
            code,
            repr(getattr(function, "__defaults__", None)),
            repr(getattr(function, "__kwdefaults__", None)),
        ))
    # Retain the actual module/function references in the key: a stable
    # function object can otherwise keep its identity while a relevant global
    # binding is replaced in place.
    return (tuple(identities), global_bindings, id(hashlib.sha256))


@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
def _canonical_inventory_snapshot(raw, expected_sha256, expected_generation,
                                  validator_contract, failure_message):
    """Cache only a pure parse/canonicalization transform keyed by exact bytes.

    Callers reread the bytes on every invocation. The cached payload is a
    marshal serialization, never a parsed mutable object or authentication
    verdict; every return is decoded into a new object graph.
    """
    if type(raw) is not bytes:
        raise ValueError(failure_message)
    inventory = json.loads(raw)
    if (type(inventory) is not dict
            or safe.canonical(inventory) != raw
            or safe.canonical_digest(inventory) != expected_sha256
            or inventory.get("canonical_sha256") != expected_sha256
            or inventory.get("generation") != expected_generation):
        raise ValueError(failure_message)
    return marshal.dumps(inventory, 4)


def _read_canonical_inventory_snapshot(reader, predecessor, failure_message):
    raw = reader(predecessor["path"])

    payload = _canonical_inventory_snapshot(
        raw,
        predecessor["canonical_sha256"],
        predecessor["generation"],
        _inventory_validation_contract(),
        failure_message,
    )
    return raw, marshal.loads(payload)

def read_blob(path):
    """Read a tracked source blob, reusing bytes only inside one fenced audit.

    The enclosing checkpoint receipt scope binds HEAD, index, filtered
    worktree, Git configuration and A2 bytes at entry/exit.  A cache entry is
    only the immutable HEAD blob already checked by ``safe.read_blob``; it is
    never an identity or PASS verdict.  Each hit still checks the path's
    filesystem type/link posture and the relevant reader contract.
    """
    from runtime import source_identity
    relative = source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path(path)
    scope = _active_checkpoint_derivation_scope()
    if scope is None:
        return safe.read_blob(relative)
    contract = _scoped_source_read_contract()
    key = "pass-a.source-blob:" + relative
    cached = scope.load_derivation(key, contract)
    if cached is not None:
        if type(cached) is not bytes:
            raise ValueError('Pass-A scoped source blob is not immutable bytes')
        _verify_scoped_source_path(relative)
        if contract != _scoped_source_read_contract():
            raise ValueError('Pass-A source reader changed during scoped reuse')
        return cached
    raw = safe.read_blob(relative)
    if type(raw) is not bytes:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A source reader returned non-byte data')
    if contract != _scoped_source_read_contract():
        raise ValueError('Pass-A source reader changed during scoped read')
    scope.store_derivation(key, contract, raw)
    return raw


def _active_checkpoint_derivation_scope():
    engine = sys.modules.get('scripts.audit_core_01d_checkpoint_e_completion_v8')
    if engine is None:
        return None
    active = engine._ACTIVE_RECEIPT_SCOPES.get()
    preferred = active.get('checkpoint-master-audit')
    if (preferred is not None and getattr(preferred, 'enabled', False)
            and getattr(preferred, 'unit', None) == engine._execution_unit()
            and callable(getattr(preferred, 'load_derivation', None))
            and callable(getattr(preferred, 'store_derivation', None))):
        return preferred
    # ContextVar mappings preserve insertion order.  The first enabled scope
    # is the outermost bounded audit owner and survives short-lived child
    # scopes, whose derivation dictionaries are cleared on exit.
    unit = engine._execution_unit()
    for scope in tuple(active.values()):
        if (getattr(scope, 'enabled', False)
                and getattr(scope, 'unit', None) == unit
                and callable(getattr(scope, 'load_derivation', None))
                and callable(getattr(scope, 'store_derivation', None))):
            return scope
    return None


def _scoped_source_read_contract():
    """Bind the reader and path-validation code used by scoped byte reuse."""
    from runtime import source_identity
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, function in (
        ('pass_a.read_blob', read_blob),
        ('safe.read_blob', safe.read_blob),
        ('safe._read_blob', safe._read_blob),
        ('safe._source_scope_head', safe._source_scope_head),
        ('safe._verify_scoped_source_inputs', safe._verify_scoped_source_inputs),
        ('source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob', source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob),
        ('source_identity._run_git', source_identity._run_git),
        ('source_identity._tracked_worktree_path', source_identity._tracked_worktree_path),
        ('source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path',
         source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path),
    ):
        digest.update(name.encode('utf-8') + b'\0')
        digest.update(repr((id(function), id(getattr(function, '__code__', None)),
                            getattr(function, '__defaults__', None),
                            getattr(function, '__kwdefaults__', None))).encode('utf-8'))
    digest.update(repr((str(ROOT), str(safe.ROOT), id(safe), id(source_identity))).encode('utf-8'))
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _verify_scoped_source_path(path):
    """Repeat cheap filesystem-type checks on a scoped immutable-byte hit."""
    import stat
    from pathlib import Path
    from runtime import source_identity
    root = Path(safe.ROOT).resolve(strict=True)
    source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path(path)
    target = root.joinpath(*path.split('/'))
    current = root
    for part in path.split('/'):
        current = current / part
        metadata = current.lstat()
        is_last = current == target
        regular = stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) if is_last else stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode)
        if (not regular or stat.S_ISLNK(metadata.st_mode)
                or getattr(metadata, 'st_file_attributes', 0) & 0x400
                or (is_last and getattr(metadata, 'st_nlink', 1) != 1)):
            raise ValueError('Pass-A scoped source path is linked or nonregular: ' + path)


def _scoped_tracked_head_reader_contract():
    """Bind the exact Git reader and per-hit filesystem checks for HEAD bytes."""
    from runtime import source_identity
    functions = (
        ('source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob', source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob),
        ('source_identity._ensure_repository_root', source_identity._ensure_repository_root),
        ('source_identity._run_git', source_identity._run_git),
        ('source_identity._ascii_git_output', source_identity._ascii_git_output),
        ('source_identity._tracked_worktree_path', source_identity._tracked_worktree_path),
        ('source_identity.read_raw_file_bytes', source_identity.read_raw_file_bytes),
        ('source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path',
         source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path),
        ('source_identity.DevelopmentSourceIdentity', source_identity.DevelopmentSourceIdentity),
        ('hashlib.sha256', hashlib.sha256),
        ('marshal.dumps', marshal.dumps),
        ('marshal.loads', marshal.loads),
        ('PassA._active_checkpoint_derivation_scope', _active_checkpoint_derivation_scope),
        ('PassA._verify_scoped_source_path', _verify_scoped_source_path),
        ('PassA._tracked_head_mode', _tracked_head_mode),
        ('PassA.read_tracked_head_blob_scoped', read_tracked_head_blob_scoped),
    )
    entries = []
    for name, function in functions:
        code = getattr(function, '__code__', None)
        entries.append((name, id(function), id(code),
                        repr(getattr(function, '__defaults__', None)),
                        repr(getattr(function, '__kwdefaults__', None))))
    return hashlib.sha256(repr((str(ROOT), id(source_identity), tuple(entries))).encode()).hexdigest()


def _tracked_head_mode(root, relative, expected_blob):
    """Read and validate one HEAD tree entry when a scoped blob is first seen."""
    from runtime import source_identity
    entry = source_identity._run_git(root, 'ls-tree', '-z', 'HEAD', '--', relative)
    if type(entry) is not bytes or entry.count(b'\0') != 1 or not entry.endswith(b'\0'):
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source tree entry is malformed: ' + relative)
    metadata, logical = entry[:-1].split(b'\t', 1)
    fields = metadata.split()
    if (len(fields) != 3 or fields[1] != b'blob'
            or logical != relative.encode('utf-8')
            or fields[2].decode('ascii', 'strict') != expected_blob):
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source HEAD entry differs from its blob: ' + relative)
    return fields[0].decode('ascii', 'strict')


def read_tracked_head_blob_scoped(repository_root, relative_path, *,
                                  verify_worktree_filtered_identity=True,
                                  expected_mode=None):
    """Reuse immutable HEAD bytes only within the active fenced checkpoint scope.

    Scope hits still re-check every path component with lstat, reject links,
    reparse points, non-regular files and multiply-linked files, and compare
    the source-identity reader contract. HEAD/index/worktree/filter state is
    bounded by the owning receipt scope's entry/exit state digest. Outside that
    scope this delegates to the ordinary source-identity reader.
    """
    from pathlib import Path
    from runtime import source_identity
    relative = source_identity.validate_repository_relative_path(relative_path)
    if type(verify_worktree_filtered_identity) is not bool:
        raise source_identity.SourceIdentityError(
            'verify_worktree_filtered_identity must be exact bool')
    if expected_mode is not None and (type(expected_mode) is not str
                                      or expected_mode not in {'100644', '100755'}):
        raise source_identity.SourceIdentityError('expected_mode is malformed')
    try:
        root = Path(repository_root).resolve(strict=True)
    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError):
        # Preserve the ordinary reader's typed failure and diagnostics.
        return source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob(
            repository_root, relative, verify_worktree_filtered_identity=verify_worktree_filtered_identity)
    if not root.is_dir() or root != Path(ROOT).resolve(strict=True):
        result = source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob(
            repository_root, relative, verify_worktree_filtered_identity=verify_worktree_filtered_identity)
        if expected_mode is not None:
            mode = _tracked_head_mode(root, relative, result[1].git_blob_sha1)
            if mode != expected_mode:
                raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source mode differs from its exact HEAD mode: ' + relative)
        return result

    scope = _active_checkpoint_derivation_scope()
    if scope is None or not getattr(scope, 'enabled', False):
        result = source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob(
            repository_root, relative, verify_worktree_filtered_identity=verify_worktree_filtered_identity)
        if expected_mode is not None:
            mode = _tracked_head_mode(root, relative, result[1].git_blob_sha1)
            if mode != expected_mode:
                raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source mode differs from its exact HEAD mode: ' + relative)
        return result

    contract = _scoped_tracked_head_reader_contract()
    if contract != _TRUSTED_SCOPED_TRACKED_HEAD_READER_CONTRACT:
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source reader contract changed')
    key = ('pass-a.tracked-head-blob:' + str(root) + ':' + relative + ':'
           + str(verify_worktree_filtered_identity) + ':' + str(expected_mode))
    cached = scope.load_derivation(key, contract)
    if cached is not None:
        try:
            raw, fields, mode = marshal.loads(cached)
        except (EOFError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source cache payload is malformed') from exc
        if (type(raw) is not bytes or type(fields) is not tuple or len(fields) != 5
                or (mode is not None and type(mode) is not str) or fields[0] != relative
                or any(value is not None and type(value) is not str for value in fields[1:])):
            raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source cache fields are malformed')
        if expected_mode is not None and mode != expected_mode:
            raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source cached mode differs from its contract: ' + relative)
        # The caller may deliberately decline the filtered-worktree identity
        # comparison for an immutable predecessor fixture, but path type/link
        # checks remain mandatory on every scoped hit.
        _verify_scoped_source_path(relative)
        if contract != _scoped_tracked_head_reader_contract():
            raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source reader changed during cache hit')
        identity = source_identity.DevelopmentSourceIdentity(*fields)
        return raw, identity

    result = source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob(
        repository_root, relative,
        verify_worktree_filtered_identity=verify_worktree_filtered_identity)
    raw, identity = result
    if type(raw) is not bytes or type(identity) is not source_identity.DevelopmentSourceIdentity:
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source reader returned an invalid result')
    mode = (_tracked_head_mode(root, relative, identity.git_blob_sha1)
            if expected_mode is not None else None)
    if expected_mode is not None and mode != expected_mode:
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source mode differs from its exact HEAD mode: ' + relative)
    if verify_worktree_filtered_identity:
        _verify_scoped_source_path(relative)
    if contract != _scoped_tracked_head_reader_contract():
        raise ValueError('scoped tracked-source reader changed during authenticated read')
    fields = (identity.repository_relative_path, identity.git_blob_sha1,
              identity.git_blob_payload_sha256,
              identity.filtered_worktree_git_blob_sha1, identity.raw_worktree_sha256)
    scope.store_derivation(key, contract, marshal.dumps((raw, fields, mode), 4))
    return result


_TRUSTED_SCOPED_TRACKED_HEAD_READER_CONTRACT = _scoped_tracked_head_reader_contract()


def _tests_shard_v2_receipt(*, _reader=None):

            or value.get('policy_id') != 'ATHENA_P4_TESTS_EIGHT_SHARD_BALANCE_MAINTENANCE_V2'
            or value.get('schema_version') != 1
            or type(source_forward) is not dict
            or set(source_forward) != TESTS_SHARD_V2_SOURCE_PATHS
            or value.get('authority_granted') is not False
            or value.get('historical_bytes_changed') is not False
            or value.get('required_contexts_changed') is not False
            or value.get('source_authority_changed') is not False):
        raise ValueError('Tests shard V2 source-forward receipt drift')

def _tests_shard_v2_predecessor_source(path, raw, *, _reader=None):
    reader = read_blob if _reader is None else _reader
    if path not in TESTS_SHARD_V2_SOURCE_PATHS:
        return raw
    value = _tests_shard_v2_receipt(_reader=reader)
    row = value['source_forward'][path]
    actual = reader(path)
    if raw != actual:
        raise ValueError('Tests shard V2 caller current source identity drift: ' + path)
    actual = _ci_assertion_predecessor_source(path, actual, _reader=reader)
    actual = _root_performance_project_checked_source(path, actual, _reader=reader)
    current = _parent_progress_predecessor_source(path, actual, _reader=reader)
    raw = current
    before = reader(row['fixture'])
    if (type(row) is not dict or set(row) != {'fixture', 'before', 'after'}
            or safe.identity(current) != row.get('after')
            or safe.identity(raw) != row.get('after') or raw != current
            or safe.identity(before) != row.get('before')):
        raise ValueError('Tests shard V2 current/predecessor source identity drift: ' + path)
    return before


def _receipt_for_reader(*, _reader=None):
    reader = read_blob if _reader is None else _reader
    raw = reader(RECEIPT)
    value = json.loads(raw)
    if (safe.canonical(value) != raw or safe.canonical_digest(value) != RECEIPT_SHA256
            or value.get('canonical_sha256') != RECEIPT_SHA256
            or value.get('authority_granted') is not False
            or value.get('workflow_changed') is not False
            or value.get('historical_bytes_changed') is not False
            or value.get('source_forward') != EDGES):
        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests source successor receipt drift')
    return value

def receipt():

def _predecessor_source_for_reader(path, raw, *, _reader=None):
    reader = read_blob if _reader is None else _reader
    if path == 'scripts/audit_phase_a_pc_upcoming_retention_successor.py':
        raw = _root_performance_predecessor_source(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    if path == safe.SOURCE:
        raw = _git_mode_regression_predecessor(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    raw = _blob_reuse_predecessor(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    raw = _integrated_lineage_predecessor(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    raw = _tests_shard_v2_predecessor_source(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    if path in CI_ASSERTION_V2_PATHS and path not in ROOT_PERFORMANCE_PATHS:
        raw = _ci_assertion_predecessor_source(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    if path == B1_SOURCE:
        return _b1_predecessor_source(path, reader(path), _reader=reader)
    row = EDGES.get(path)
    if row is None:
        return _a2_text_predecessor_source(path, raw, _reader=reader)
    _receipt_for_reader(_reader=reader)
    if safe.identity(raw) != row['after']:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests current source identity drift: ' + path)
    before = reader(row['fixture'])
    if safe.identity(before) != row['before']:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests predecessor source identity drift: ' + path)
    expected = before
    if 'replacement_before' in row:
        old, new = row['replacement_before'].encode(), row['replacement_after'].encode()
        if expected.count(old) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests source recipe is not unique: ' + path)
        expected = expected.replace(old, new)
    expected += row.get('append', '').encode()
    if expected != raw:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests source exceeds exact recipe: ' + path)
    return before

def predecessor_source(path, raw):
    return _predecessor_source_for_reader(path, raw)



def _authenticate_core_for_reader(*, _reader=None):

    _authenticate_a2_text_successor(_reader=reader)

        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests successor regression source drift')
    _authenticate_root_performance(_reader=reader)
    _authenticate_ci_assertion_successor(_reader=reader)
    return value

def historical_workflow_source():
    """Only this historical audit receives old YAML; caller cannot choose a tree."""
    authenticate_core()
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    from scripts import audit_tests_shard_balance_successor as shards
    latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    rows = [row for row in latest['source_identities'] if row['path'] == SOURCE]
    if (type(latest.get('generation')) is not int or latest['generation'] < 358
            or rows != [{'path': SOURCE, 'lf_source_sha256': EDGES[SOURCE]['after']['source_sha256']}]):
        raise ValueError('Pass-A current auditor is not authenticated by latest A2')
    b1_rows = [row for row in latest['source_identities'] if row['path'] == B1_SOURCE]
    if (latest['generation'] < 362
            or b1_rows != [{'path': B1_SOURCE, 'lf_source_sha256':
                _integrated_lineage_receipt()['source_forward'][B1_SOURCE]['after']['source_sha256']}]):
        raise ValueError('B1 current test source is not authenticated by the A2 successor')
    shards.authenticate()  # Proves actual HEAD tree plus one-path inverse.
    current = read_blob(shards.WORKFLOW)
    before = read_blob(shards.FIXTURE)
    if safe.identity(current) != shards.AFTER or safe.identity(before) != shards.BEFORE:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A Tests workflow or historical predecessor drift')
    # The frozen Pass-A row is an independent, immutable source anchor.
    frozen_raw = read_blob(receipt()['frozen_inventory']['path'])
    if safe.identity(frozen_raw) != FROZEN_IDENTITY:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A frozen inventory bytes drift')
    frozen = json.loads(frozen_raw)
    if (safe.canonical_digest(frozen) != receipt()['frozen_inventory']['canonical_sha256']
            or frozen.get('canonical_sha256') != receipt()['frozen_inventory']['canonical_sha256']):
        raise ValueError('Pass-A frozen inventory identity drift')
    expected = [row for row in frozen['sources'] if row['path'] == shards.WORKFLOW]
    if expected != [{'path': shards.WORKFLOW, 'git_blob_sha1': shards.BEFORE['git_blob_sha1'],
                     'normalized_source_sha256': shards.BEFORE['source_sha256']}]:
        raise ValueError('Pass-A frozen Tests workflow identity drift')
    return before

class _ParentNodeProgress:
    """Explicit CLI-only plugin; importing the auditor has no reporting effects."""

    def __init__(self):
        import os
        import sys
        self.pid = os.getpid()
        self.stream = sys.__stdout__

    def _emit(self, event, nodeid, **fields):
        import os
        from datetime import datetime, timezone
        if os.getpid() != self.pid or self.stream is None:
            return
        value = {'event': event, 'nodeid': nodeid, 'pid': self.pid,
                 'utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), **fields}
        self.stream.write('\nATHENA_PYTEST_PROGRESS ' + json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        self.stream.flush()

    def pytest_sessionstart(self, session):
        self._emit('session_start', '')

    def pytest_runtest_logstart(self, nodeid, location):
        self._emit('start', nodeid)

    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        self._emit(report.when, report.nodeid, outcome=report.outcome,
                   seconds=round(report.duration, 6))

    def pytest_runtest_logfinish(self, nodeid, location):
        self._emit('finish', nodeid)

    config.pluginmanager.register(_ParentNodeProgress(), 'athena-parent-node-progress')

class _SourceReadScope:
    """Local immutable inputs for exactly one independently fenced audit call."""

    def __init__(self, reader: Callable[[str], bytes]) -> None:
        from runtime import source_identity
        self.root = safe.ROOT
        self.head = safe._source_scope_head(self.root)
        self.reader = reader
        self.safe_reader = safe.read_blob
        self.runtime_reader = source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob
        self.sources: dict[str, bytes] = {}
        self.derivation_bytes: dict[str, tuple[str, bytes]] = {}

    def read(self, path: str) -> bytes:
        if path not in self.sources:
            raw = self.reader(path)
            if type(raw) is not bytes:
                raise ValueError('scoped source input must be immutable bytes')
            self.sources[path] = raw
        return self.sources[path]

    def verify(self) -> None:
        from runtime import source_identity
        if (safe.ROOT != self.root or read_blob is not self.reader
                or safe.read_blob is not self.safe_reader
                or source_identity.read_tracked_head_blob is not self.runtime_reader):
            raise ValueError('scoped source root or reader changed during authentication')
        safe._verify_scoped_source_inputs(self.root, self.head, self.sources)

    def load_derivation(self, name: str, contract: str) -> bytes | None:
        entry = self.derivation_bytes.get(name)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        prior_contract, payload = entry
        if prior_contract != contract or type(payload) is not bytes:
            raise ValueError('Pass-A scoped derivation contract changed')
        return payload

    def store_derivation(self, name: str, contract: str, payload: bytes) -> None:
        if type(payload) is not bytes:
            raise ValueError('Pass-A scoped derivation payload is mutable')
        self.derivation_bytes[name] = (contract, payload)

def _ci_assertion_predecessor_source(path, raw, *, _reader=None):

                    raise ValueError('CI assertion V2 source patch seam drift: ' + path)

            or rows != [{'path': SOURCE, 'lf_source_sha256': EDGES[SOURCE]['after']['source_sha256']}]):
        raise ValueError('Pass-A current auditor is not authenticated by latest A2')

                     'normalized_source_sha256': shards.BEFORE['source_sha256']}]:

class _ParentNodeProgress:
    """Explicit CLI-only plugin; importing the auditor has no reporting effects."""

    def __init__(self):
        import os
        import sys
        self.pid = os.getpid()
        self.stream = sys.__stdout__

    def _emit(self, event, nodeid, **fields):
        import os
        from datetime import datetime, timezone
        if os.getpid() != self.pid or self.stream is None:
            return
        value = {'event': event, 'nodeid': nodeid, 'pid': self.pid,
                 'utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), **fields}
        self.stream.write('\nATHENA_PYTEST_PROGRESS ' + json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        self.stream.flush()

    def pytest_sessionstart(self, session):
        self._emit('session_start', '')

    def pytest_runtest_logstart(self, nodeid, location):
        self._emit('start', nodeid)

    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        self._emit(report.when, report.nodeid, outcome=report.outcome,
                   seconds=round(report.duration, 6))

    def pytest_runtest_logfinish(self, nodeid, location):
        self._emit('finish', nodeid)

    current_rows = {row["path"]: row["lf_source_sha256"] for row in latest["source_identities"]}

    for path, descriptor in predecessors.items():
        payload, observed = _read_tracked_head_blob_scoped(ROOT, descriptor["fixture"])

                key: descriptor[key] for key in BEFORE} or observed.git_blob_sha1 != descriptor["git_blob_sha1"]:
            raise ValueError("retention historical predecessor drift: " + path)
    for path, expected in added_metadata.items():
        payload, observed = _read_tracked_head_blob_scoped(ROOT, path)
        if identity(payload.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")) != expected or observed.git_blob_sha1 != expected["git_blob_sha1"]:
            raise ValueError("retention additive evidence identity drift: " + path)
        current_blobs[path] = observed.git_blob_sha1
    result = []
    for line in raw.splitlines(keepends=True):
        metadata, separator, logical = line.partition(b"\t")

            if metadata.split() != [b"100644", b"blob", current_blobs[path].encode()]:

def _retention_scope_contract_components():
    """Return labeled identities for the verifier contract used by scoped reuse."""
    def stable_code(code):
        def constant(value):
            if isinstance(value, types.CodeType):
                return {"code": stable_code(value).hex()}
            if isinstance(value, tuple):
                return [constant(item) for item in value]
            if isinstance(value, bytes):
                return {"bytes": value.hex()}
            return {"type": type(value).__qualname__, "value": repr(value)}

        fields = {
            "bytecode": code.co_code.hex(),
            "constants": [constant(item) for item in code.co_consts],
            "names": code.co_names,
            "varnames": code.co_varnames,
            "freevars": code.co_freevars,
            "cellvars": code.co_cellvars,
            "argcount": code.co_argcount,
            "posonlyargcount": code.co_posonlyargcount,
            "kwonlyargcount": code.co_kwonlyargcount,
            "nlocals": code.co_nlocals,
            "flags": code.co_flags,
            "filename": code.co_filename,
            "firstlineno": code.co_firstlineno,
            "linetable": code.co_linetable.hex(),
            "exceptiontable": code.co_exceptiontable.hex(),
        }
        return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
            fields, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False
        ).encode("utf-8")).digest()

    components = {}
    for name in (
        "_read", "_raw_blob", "_bootstrap_blob", "identity", "_json",
        "expected_workflow", "authenticate", "_authenticate_before_pass_a_tests",
        "authenticate_main_prefix", "authenticate_provisional_archive",
        "authenticate_bootstrap_sources", "_project_retention_inventory_uncached",
        "project_retention_inventory",
    ):
        value = globals().get(name)
        code = getattr(value, "__code__", None)
        if code is None:
            return None
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        digest.update(stable_code(code))
        digest.update(repr((getattr(value, "__defaults__", None),
                            getattr(value, "__kwdefaults__", None))).encode("utf-8"))
        components["function:" + name] = (
            str(id(value)) + ":" + str(id(code)) + ":" + digest.hexdigest())
    for name in (
        "RECEIPT", "RECEIPT_SHA256", "SNAPSHOT", "SNAPSHOT_SHA256",
        "PREDECESSORS", "HISTORICAL_PREDECESSORS", "BOOTSTRAP_PREDECESSORS",
        "BOOTSTRAP_AFTER", "BOOTSTRAP_METADATA", "ADDED_METADATA",
        "ADDED_PYTHON_PATHS", "ADDED_PYTHON_IDENTITIES", "LINKED_METADATA",
        "BOOTSTRAP_AUDITOR_PATCHES", "HISTORICAL_FORWARD_RECEIPT",
        "HISTORICAL_FORWARD_SHA256", "B4_FORWARD_RECEIPT", "B4_FORWARD_SHA256",
    ):
        raw = json.dumps(globals().get(name), sort_keys=True,
                         separators=(",", ":"), default=repr).encode("utf-8")
        components["constant:" + name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    return components


def _retention_scope_contract():
    """Bind the exact local verifier functions/constants used by scoped reuse."""
    components = _retention_scope_contract_components()
    if components is None:
        return None

def project_retention_inventory(raw, *, latest=None):
    """Compose only this exact successor AFTER older historical projections.

    New files disappear only after their precise identities are verified. An
    existing row is restored only if it still names the current HEAD blob;
    already-authenticated older views remain untouched. Unknown rows survive
    and are rejected by the caller's unchanged historical inventory digest.
    """
    from runtime.source_identity import read_tracked_head_blob
    from scripts import audit_core_01d_ci_offline_transport_boundary as a2
    authenticate()
    _json(HISTORICAL_FORWARD_RECEIPT, HISTORICAL_FORWARD_SHA256)
    if latest is None:
        latest = a2.authenticate_inventory()
    if latest.get("generation", 0) < 348:
        raise ValueError("historical retention projection requires its A2 successor")
    authenticate_bootstrap_sources()
    predecessors = dict(HISTORICAL_PREDECESSORS)
    for path, descriptor in BOOTSTRAP_PREDECESSORS.items():
        if path not in predecessors:
            predecessors[path] = dict(descriptor, after=BOOTSTRAP_AFTER[path])
    added_metadata = dict(ADDED_METADATA, **BOOTSTRAP_METADATA)
    expected_paths = (set(predecessors) | set(ADDED_PYTHON_PATHS) | set(added_metadata)
                      | {value["fixture"] for value in predecessors.values()})
    tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "HEAD", "--", *sorted(expected_paths)], cwd=ROOT)
    modes = {line.split(b"\t", 1)[1].decode(): line.split(b"\t", 1)[0].split()[:2]
             for line in tree.splitlines()}
    if set(modes) != expected_paths or any(value != [b"100644", b"blob"] for value in modes.values()):
        raise ValueError("retention source/evidence inventory mode changed")
    current_rows = {row["path"]: row["lf_source_sha256"] for row in latest["source_identities"]}
    current_blobs = {}
    for path in set(predecessors) | set(ADDED_PYTHON_PATHS):
        payload, observed = read_tracked_head_blob(ROOT, path)
        payload = payload.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
        if path.endswith(".py") and current_rows.get(path) != hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest():
            raise ValueError("retention current source is not A2 authenticated: " + path)
        if path == WORKFLOW and payload != expected_workflow():
            raise ValueError("retention workflow projection source drift")
        expected_after = BOOTSTRAP_AFTER.get(path) or (predecessors[path]["after"] if path in predecessors
                          else ADDED_PYTHON_IDENTITIES.get(path))
        if expected_after is not None and identity(payload) != expected_after:
            raise ValueError("source differs from the exact reviewed retention successor: " + path)
        current_blobs[path] = observed.git_blob_sha1
    for path, descriptor in predecessors.items():
        payload, observed = read_tracked_head_blob(ROOT, descriptor["fixture"])
        if identity(payload.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")) != {
                key: descriptor[key] for key in BEFORE} or observed.git_blob_sha1 != descriptor["git_blob_sha1"]:
            raise ValueError("retention historical predecessor drift: " + path)
    for path, expected in added_metadata.items():
        payload, observed = read_tracked_head_blob(ROOT, path)
        if identity(payload.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")) != expected or observed.git_blob_sha1 != expected["git_blob_sha1"]:
            raise ValueError("retention additive evidence identity drift: " + path)
        current_blobs[path] = observed.git_blob_sha1
    result = []
    for line in raw.splitlines(keepends=True):
        metadata, separator, logical = line.partition(b"\t")
        path = logical.strip().decode("utf-8")
        if path in added_metadata or path in ADDED_PYTHON_PATHS:
            if metadata.split() != [b"100644", b"blob", current_blobs[path].encode()]:
                raise ValueError("retention additive inventory mode/blob drift: " + path)
            continue
        if path in predecessors and metadata.rsplit(b" ", 1)[-1].decode() == current_blobs[path]:
            if metadata.split()[:2] != [b"100644", b"blob"]:
                raise ValueError("retention predecessor inventory mode changed: " + path)
            metadata = b"100644 blob " + predecessors[path]["git_blob_sha1"].encode()
            line = metadata + separator + logical
        result.append(line)
    return b"".join(result)

    original_successor = extension["successor"]["lf_source_sha256"]

        with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="E3 source-forward successor extension is missing or altered"):

def test_scoped_a2_cache_hit_rehashes_v376_when_stat_changes_and_recovers():
    from scripts import audit_checkpoint_e_workflows as checkpoint

        boundary.INVENTORY_PREFIX + "v376.json")
    original = v376.read_bytes()
    altered = bytearray(original)
    altered[0] ^= 1
    altered = bytes(altered)
    assert len(altered) == len(original)

    try:
        # The in-scope load hit must notice the changed stat tuple, reread V376,
        # and reject its raw bytes immediately. Restoring the content cannot
        # restore ctime, so the owning scope also correctly rejects at exit.
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="receipt execution state changed during scope:.*a2-path-stat:.*v376"):
            with checkpoint._checkpoint_master_scope():
                assert boundary.authenticate_inventory()["generation"] == 377
                try:
                    v376.write_bytes(altered)
                    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="receipt execution state changed during scope: a2-bytes:.*v376"):
                        boundary.load_inventory_generations()
                finally:
                    v376.write_bytes(original)
    finally:
        if v376.read_bytes() != original:
            v376.write_bytes(original)

    # A later independent scope sees the restored canonical bytes and remains
    # usable; no failed derivation or mutation state leaked across calls.
    with checkpoint._checkpoint_master_scope():
        assert len(boundary.load_inventory_generations()) == 377
        assert boundary.authenticate_inventory()["generation"] == 377

def test_e3_pass_a_source_successor_extension_is_append_only_and_exact(monkeypatch):
    path = boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SUCCESSOR_EXTENSION_PATH
    chain = boundary.load_inventory_generations()
    latest = chain[-1][1]
    extensions = boundary._e3_cross_contract_source_forward_successor_extensions()
    assert latest["generation"] >= boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SUCCESSOR_EXTENSION_GENERATION
    assert latest["e3_cross_contract_source_forward_successor_extensions"] == extensions
    record = extensions[0]
    assert record["path"] == path
    assert record["generation"] == boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SUCCESSOR_EXTENSION_GENERATION
    assert record["previous_successor"]["generation"] == boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_AUTHORIZATION_GENERATION
    assert record["previous_successor"]["git_blob_sha1"] == (
        boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_TRANSITIONS[path]["successor_git_blob_sha1"]
    )
    assert record["authority_granted"] is False
    assert record["historical_bytes_changed"] is False
    assert record["rewritten"] is False
    # The source reader must still return the exact V284 predecessor bytes.
    predecessor = boundary.read_authenticated_cross_contract_predecessor(path)
    transition = boundary.E3_CROSS_CONTRACT_SOURCE_FORWARD_TRANSITIONS[path]
    assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(predecessor)).encode() + b"\0" + predecessor).hexdigest() == (
        transition["predecessor_git_blob_sha1"]
    )

    original = boundary.load_inventory_generations
    def altered(directory=None):
        rows = list(original(directory))
        generation, document = rows[-1]
        changed = json.loads(json.dumps(document))
        changed["e3_cross_contract_source_forward_successor_extensions"][0]["successor"]["git_blob_sha1"] = "0" * 40
        rows[-1] = (generation, changed)
        return rows
    monkeypatch.setattr(boundary, "load_inventory_generations", altered)
    # Latest-generation source/authentication integrity is checked before the
    # extension reader returns any predecessor bytes. This is the stable
    # fail-closed layer for a tampered persisted generation.
    with pytest.raises(
        AssertionError,
        match="E3 Pass-A latest A2 authorization or generation link drift",
    ):
        boundary.read_authenticated_cross_contract_predecessor(path)

def test_e3_v309_predecessor_fixture_is_exact_and_tampering_fails_closed(monkeypatch):
    chain = boundary.load_inventory_generations()
    extension = next(
        row for row in boundary._e3_cross_contract_source_forward_successor_extensions(
            chain=chain,
            generation=boundary.E3_PASS_A_V309_SUCCESSOR_EXTENSION_GENERATION,
        )

    )

    raw = boundary._authenticate_e3_v309_predecessor_fixture(extension)
    assert len(raw) == expected["byte_size"]
    normalized = raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
    assert hashlib.sha256(normalized).hexdigest() == expected["lf_source_sha256"]

    fixture_path = boundary.ROOT / expected["fixture_path"]
    original_open = Path.open

    def read_tampered_worktree(path, *args, **kwargs):
        if path == fixture_path and args and args[0] == "rb":
            return io.BytesIO(raw + b"tampered")
        return original_open(path, *args, **kwargs)

    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        # Keep safe path and HEAD object checks real; tamper only the bounded
        # worktree read so this proves checkout drift is rejected.
        patch.setattr(Path, "open", read_tampered_worktree)
        with pytest.raises(
            AssertionError,
            match="V309 predecessor fixture checkout differs from exact HEAD text",
        ):
            boundary._authenticate_e3_v309_predecessor_fixture(extension)

    altered = json.loads(json.dumps(extension))
    altered["predecessor_fixture"]["git_blob_sha1"] = "0" * 40
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="V309 source predecessor fixture authorization drift"):
        boundary._authenticate_e3_v309_predecessor_fixture(altered)

def test_depth1_checkout_proves_historical_evidence_from_pinned_identities(monkeypatch):
    """Hosted CI checks out fetch-depth 1: no ancestor object, no fetch allowed."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(boundary, "historical_objects_available", lambda *args, **kwargs: False)
    assert boundary.audit()["historical_proof_mode"] == "PINNED_IDENTITY_CHAIN_DEPTH1"
    assert boundary.authenticate_historical_v1()["canonical_sha256"] == V1_CANONICAL_SHA256
    assert boundary.authenticate_historical_activation_and_no_bypass() is True
    assert boundary.read(boundary.RECEIPT_PATH) == boundary.build_receipt()
    assert boundary.authenticate_inventory()["generation"] == len(boundary.discover_inventory_generations())
    # The fallback reads pinned A2 identities rather than current worktree
    # bytes: this bridge changed sitecustomize.py, so those differ from A2.
    pinned = boundary.historical_source("sitecustomize.py")["lf_source_sha256"]
    assert pinned == V1_SITECUSTOMIZE_SHA256
    assert pinned != boundary.source("sitecustomize.py")["lf_source_sha256"]

    historical_transport = boundary.historical_text("tests/offline_transport.py")
    assert hashlib.sha256(historical_transport.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == (
        boundary.pinned_historical_identity("tests/offline_transport.py")
    )
    assert hashlib.sha256(historical_transport.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != (
        boundary.source("tests/offline_transport.py")["lf_source_sha256"]
    )

    original = Path.read_bytes
    def altered(path):
        if Path(path) == boundary.ROOT / "tests/conftest.py":
            return b"# rewritten after A2\n"
        return original(path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", altered)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="pinned historical text is not the reviewed A2 source"):
        boundary.historical_text("tests/conftest.py")
